modules.title: 我吃完飯了，你呢？
modules.title_py: Wǒ chī wán fàn le, nǐ ne?
modules.title_id: I've finished eating — what about you?
modules.scene: Seven in the evening in the dorm kitchen. Zhiming has just come back from class and hasn't eaten; Annie saved some fried rice for him. After eating and washing up, they watch a movie to the end.
can_do: Ask and answer whether someone has eaten/done something (吃過了嗎？／吃完了嗎？)
Tell 'already' (V過2) apart from 'ever' (V過1) when listening
Order your evening activities: finish A, then B (V完…就…／接著…)
modules.exam_link: Routines & housework are a FREQUENT topic in 聽力 Parts 1–2 and 閱讀 Parts 1–2. The polite phrase 吃過了 (a soft way to decline an invitation) is a typical implicature pattern in 聽力 Part 4.

dialogs.title_id: Seven in the evening, dorm kitchen

lines.zh: 安妮，你吃過飯了嗎？
lines.py: Ān nī, nǐ chī guò fàn le ma?
lines.id: Annie, have you eaten?

lines.zh: 吃過了，剛才在廚房吃的。你呢？
lines.py: Chī guò le, gāng cái zài chú fáng chī de. Nǐ ne?
lines.id: Yes, I just ate in the kitchen. What about you?

lines.zh: 我剛下課，現在才要吃。
lines.py: Wǒ gāng xià kè, xiàn zài cái yào chī.
lines.id: I've just finished class; I'm only about to eat now.

lines.zh: 廚房裡還有一些炒飯，我做得太多了。你吃吧！
lines.py: Chú fáng lǐ hái yǒu yì xiē chǎo fàn, wǒ zuò de tài duō le. Nǐ chī ba!
lines.id: There's still some fried rice in the kitchen — I made too much. Have some!

lines.zh: 太好了！謝謝你！
lines.py: Tài hǎo le! Xiè xie nǐ!
lines.id: Great! Thank you!

lines.zh: 炒飯都吃光了，太好吃了！碗我自己洗。
lines.py: Chǎo fàn dōu chī guāng le, tài hǎo chī le! Wǎn wǒ zì jǐ xǐ.
lines.id: I finished all the fried rice, it was delicious! I'll wash the bowl myself.

lines.zh: 好，洗完了放在餐桌上就好。
lines.py: Hǎo, xǐ wán le fàng zài cān zhuō shàng jiù hǎo.
lines.id: OK, when you've washed it, just put it on the dining table.

lines.zh: 你功課寫完了嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ gōng kè xiě wán le ma?
lines.id: Have you finished your homework?

lines.zh: 寫完了。明天的考試，我也準備了。
lines.py: Xiě wán le. Míng tiān de kǎo shì, wǒ yě zhǔn bèi le.
lines.id: Yes. I've prepared for tomorrow's exam too.

lines.zh: 那我們接著看電影吧！
lines.py: Nà wǒ men jiē zhe kàn diàn yǐng ba!
lines.id: Then let's watch a movie next!

lines.zh: 好啊！這部電影你看過了嗎？
lines.py: Hǎo a! Zhè bù diàn yǐng nǐ kàn guò le ma?
lines.id: Sure! Have you seen this movie before?

lines.zh: 沒看過。你呢？
lines.py: Méi kàn guò. Nǐ ne?
lines.id: No, I haven't. Have you?

lines.zh: 去年看過一次，可是我很想再看一次。
lines.py: Qù nián kàn guò yí cì, kě shì wǒ hěn xiǎng zài kàn yí cì.
lines.id: I saw it once last year, but I really want to see it again.

lines.zh: 電影幾點結束？
lines.py: Diàn yǐng jǐ diǎn jié shù?
lines.id: What time does the movie end?

lines.zh: 十一點。看完電影，你早一點回家睡覺吧，明天還要考試！
lines.py: Shí yī diǎn. Kàn wán diàn yǐng, nǐ zǎo yì diǎn huí jiā shuì jiào ba, míng tiān hái yào kǎo shì!
lines.id: Eleven. After the movie, go home and get to bed early, we have a test tomorrow!

十一點半才結束。

tasks.question: 電影幾點結束？
tasks.why: 十一點半 → C. A: half an hour early. B: 半 is right, the hour is wrong.

lines.zh: 你功課寫完了嗎？
英文寫完了，中文的還要寫一個小時。
那電影呢？我們九點看，好不好？
好，寫完功課，我們接著看電影。

tasks.question: 這位先生現在要先做什麼？
tasks.why: 英文寫完了，中文的還要寫一個小時 → he is now doing his Chinese homework → B. A: after the homework is finished (接著). C: already finished.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 餐桌上的蛋糕呢？
我剛才看到小明在廚房裡吃。
那是我買給媽媽的生日蛋糕啊！
我看，已經吃光了吧。

tasks.question: 這位小姐的意思是什麼？
tasks.why: 已經吃光了吧 = it has probably all been eaten. A is reversed: the man bought the cake. B: the cake is no longer on the table. C: 小明 ate it.

options.label: he is writing homework at the dining table

tasks.why: 吃完飯 + 接著在餐桌上寫功課 → C. A: he has finished eating. B: a different activity.

picture.label: the plates on the table are all empty

tasks.why: All the plates are empty → 吃光了. B and C mean there is still food.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.

picture.label: a cinema screen showing 完 (the end), 11 o'clock

tasks.text: 電影十一點才（　），我們回家很晚。
tasks.why: They got home late because the film only ENDED at 11 → 結束. 開始 = start; 接著 = next/then, which cannot follow 才 here.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 昨天我七點才下課，回到宿舍，覺得很餓。我到廚房一看，餐桌上（1），只有一碗炒飯。室友說：「那是我做的，你吃吧！」我很快就（2），真好吃。吃完飯，我洗了碗，然後（3）。十點功課寫完了，室友問我要不要一起看電影，我們就（4）。電影很長，十二點才（5），所以今天早上我很累。
tasks.why: (1) the table is almost empty, only fried rice. (2) finished it quickly (吃光了). (3) after eating and washing up → starts homework. (4) goes on to watch a film. (5) the film only ends at 12. 「已經吃過了」 contradicts the text: he came home hungry.

tasks.instr: Read this notice, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我的室友安安每天都很忙。今天她早上八點就去學校了，晚上九點才回來。她說中午只吃了一個麵包，晚飯也沒吃。我剛才做了一些湯，還在廚房裡，就請她吃。她很快就吃光了，接著又去寫功課。她說功課明天早上要交，今天一定要寫完。
tasks.question: 這個人覺得安安今天怎麼樣？
tasks.why: 早上八點…晚上九點才回來 (busy) + 中午只吃了一個麵包，晚飯也沒吃 (hungry) → B. A: she is still hungry. C: she came back late. D: she still does her homework.

grammar.explain: 完 after a verb = the action is complete. 吃了 is just 'have eaten'; 吃完了 stresses 'have finished/it's all gone'. To ask: V完了嗎？ Negative: 沒V完. Often linked to the next activity: V完 + O，就 + V2.

examples.id: I've finished my homework.
When the film's over, I'm going straight to bed.

check.q: Choose the right word: 你的功課寫＿＿了嗎？寫完了，我們就去看電影。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 31
note: "Can/can't" form: 吃得完 / 吃不完. Asking: 這個蛋糕，你吃得完吃不完? → 這個蛋糕不大，我吃得完.

grammar.explain: V過2 + 了 = the action HAS BEEN done (usual when asked 'have you … yet?'). Compare V過1 (learned in Vol.2) = to have EVER experienced: 我看過這部電影 (I've seen this film before). Quick clue: 了 at the end and a context of routine/today → V過2.

examples.id: I've just eaten.
Have you taken your medicine today?
(V過1) I've seen this film before.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 20
note: V過 = experience (我吃過包子，很好吃). (已經)V過了 = already done, NOT experience: A: 吃飯了沒有? 這裡有包子. B: 我已經吃過了，謝謝!

core.meaning: to finish, to be over (吃完, 寫完)

core.note: This 義項 = 'used up'. 光 'light' and 'only' are not taught here.

modules.title: 房間又亂又髒！
modules.title_py: Fáng jiān yòu luàn yòu zāng!
modules.title_id: The room's messy and dirty!
modules.scene: Zhiming complains that Dawen's room is messy. While tidying up, they realize their furniture is old and the cabinet is broken, so on the weekend they go to a furniture store.
can_do: Make gentle requests with V一下 (看一下、洗一下)
Forbid with 別 (別放在沙發上)
Name furniture: 書架、書桌、櫃子、沙發、衣架
modules.exam_link: The state of the home & furniture appear in 聽力 Part 1 (pictures of rooms) and 閱讀 Parts 1–2 (dorm rules).

lines.zh: 大文，你的房間又亂又髒！
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ de fáng jiān yòu luàn yòu zāng!
lines.id: Dawen, your room is messy and dirty!

lines.zh: 對不起，我最近太忙了。
lines.py: Duì bù qǐ, wǒ zuì jìn tài máng le.
lines.id: Sorry, I've been too busy lately.

lines.zh: 你的書別放在沙發上，放在書架上吧。
lines.py: Nǐ de shū bié fàng zài shā fā shàng, fàng zài shū jià shàng ba.
lines.id: Don't put your books on the sofa — put them on the bookshelf.

lines.zh: 書架太小了，我的書太多。
lines.py: Shū jià tài xiǎo le, wǒ de shū tài duō.
lines.id: The bookshelf is too small, I have too many books.

lines.zh: 衣服也別放在椅子上，要掛在衣架上。
lines.py: Yī fú yě bié fàng zài yǐ zi shàng, yào guà zài yī jià shàng.
lines.id: Don't put your clothes on the chair either — hang them on hangers.

lines.zh: 好，我現在就去掛。
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ xiàn zài jiù qù guà.
lines.id: OK, I'll go hang them up right now.

lines.zh: 你看一下，這個櫃子也壞了。
lines.py: Nǐ kàn yí xià, zhè ge guì zi yě huài le.
lines.id: Take a look, this cabinet is broken too.

lines.zh: 對，我們的家具都太舊了。
lines.py: Duì, wǒ men de jiā jù dōu tài jiù le.
lines.id: Yes, all our furniture is too old.

lines.zh: 週末我們去看一下新的書架和櫃子吧。
lines.py: Zhōu mò wǒ men qù kàn yí xià xīn de shū jià hàn guì zi ba.
lines.id: Let's go look at a new bookshelf and cabinet this weekend.

dialogs.title_id: On the weekend, at the furniture store

lines.zh: 志明，你看，這個書架很大，也不貴。
lines.py: Zhì míng, nǐ kàn, zhè ge shū jià hěn dà, yě bú guì.
lines.id: Zhiming, look, this bookshelf is big, and it's not expensive.

lines.zh: 好！可是別買太多，我們的房間不大。
lines.py: Hǎo! Kě shì bié mǎi tài duō, wǒ men de fáng jiān bú dà.
lines.id: OK! But let's not buy too much, our room isn't big.

lines.zh: 我們再看一下書桌。
lines.py: Wǒ men zài kàn yí xià shū zhuō.
lines.id: Let's look at desks too.

lines.zh: 好，我們趕快看，商店六點關門。
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ men gǎn kuài kàn, shāng diàn liù diǎn guān mén.
lines.id: OK, let's be quick, the store closes at six.

衣架不夠了。
那你趕快去買幾個吧。

tasks.why: 衣架不夠了 + 我等一下就去 (買) → B. A: not mentioned. C: the sofa is just where the clothes were left.

我這幾天太忙了。
你媽媽明天就來了，她看到會怎麼說？
我知道，我今天晚上一定讓它乾乾淨淨的。

options: 這位先生明天要去看媽媽
這位先生應該讓房間乾淨一點
tasks.why: 她看到會怎麼說？ = your mum will not be happy to see this → clean up quickly. A: the man is the busy one. C is reversed: his mum is coming. B is the opposite.

tasks.why: Books neatly on the shelf → C. A: the opposite. B: the books are on the shelf, not on the desk.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.

picture.label: 8:50, a student running to school

tasks.text: 九點上課，現在八點五十了，你（　）走吧！
tasks.why: Class is at 9 and it is 8:50 → 趕快 (hurry). 走一下 does not mean hurry; 別走 = don't go (the opposite).

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我的室友大文很忙，所以他的房間常常（1）。昨天我跟他說：「你的衣服別放在椅子上，要（2）。」他說：「好，我等一下就掛。」可是今天我回家一看，衣服（3）。我很生氣，他就說：「對不起，我（4）。」現在他的房間乾淨多了，我們也想一起去（5）。
tasks.why: (1) a busy person's room: 又亂又髒. (2) advice: hang them on hangers. (3) the clothes were still on the chair. (4) apologises and hangs them at once. (5) plan to buy furniture. 「別放在書架上」 does not follow 要 in (2) and fits no other blank.

tasks.instr: Read these room rules, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 志明的房間又亂又髒，書桌上都是書，沙發上都是衣服。他的媽媽下個星期要來看他，所以他今天在家忙了一天：他洗了衣服，掛在衣架上；書都放在書架上。可是他的櫃子太舊了，門也壞了，他想買一個新的。他說，房間乾淨了，住得也比較舒服。
tasks.question: 志明今天為什麼在家忙了一天？
tasks.why: 媽媽下個星期要來看他，所以… → that is the reason. A is true about the cabinet, but it is not why he is busy today. B and D are not mentioned.

grammar.point: V一下 — for a moment / have a go
grammar.explain: 一下 after a verb makes an action sound brief & light, so requests sound more polite: 你看一下 (have a look), 等一下 (wait a moment), 洗一下衣服.

examples.id: Have a quick look.

examples.zh: 我們去看一下新的沙發吧。
examples.id: Let's go and look at new sofas.

check.q: A polite request: 'Please wait a moment'

grammar.explain: 別 = don't, the same as 不要 (B05) but shorter and more familiar. With 請 in front it is more polite.

examples.id: Don't put your books on the sofa.
Let's not buy one that's too expensive!

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 2
note: Suggesting NOT to do something: 還是別/不要…(了)吧 = better not …: 天氣這麼冷，我們還是別去游泳了吧.

modules.title: 請把碗洗了。
modules.title_py: Qǐng bǎ wǎn xǐ le.
modules.title_id: Please wash the dishes.
modules.scene: On Saturday morning Dawen and Zhiming split the chores: washing dishes and doing laundry. When taking out the trash, the bag tears, so they clean it up together.
can_do: Ask for something to be done to an object with 把 (把碗洗了)
Use 把 + V一V for light actions (把衣服洗一洗)
Talk about housework: 垃圾、洗衣機、乾、破、裝
modules.exam_link: 把 sentences are very common in 聽力 Parts 3–4 (instructions & requests) and 閱讀 Part 4 (paragraphs about housework).

lines.zh: 大文，家裡太髒了，我們一起弄一弄吧。
lines.py: Dà wén, jiā lǐ tài zāng le, wǒ men yì qǐ nòng yí nòng ba.
lines.id: Dawen, the place is too dirty, let's clean it up together.

lines.zh: 好。你把碗洗了，我把衣服放進洗衣機。昨天的衣服呢？
lines.py: Hǎo. Nǐ bǎ wǎn xǐ le, wǒ bǎ yī fú fàng jìn xǐ yī jī. Zuó tiān de yī fú ne?
lines.id: OK. You wash the dishes, I'll put the clothes in the washing machine. Where are yesterday's clothes?

lines.zh: 在門口，都乾了。你先拿進來吧。
lines.py: Zài mén kǒu, dōu gān le. Nǐ xiān ná jìn lái ba.
lines.id: By the door, all dry. Bring them in first.

lines.zh: 好！
lines.py: Hǎo!
lines.id: OK!

lines.zh: 碗都洗了。大文，垃圾呢？

grammar.point: 把 O V(一)V — (quickly) do something to O
grammar.explain: 把 moves the object IN FRONT of the verb to stress what is done to it. V一V (洗一洗, 弄一弄) makes the action sound light/brief.

examples.id: You wash the clothes, OK?

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 27
note: The verb in a 把 sentence must be "completed": 了, (一)V, 給 + person, number of times (寫三次), etc.: 天氣不錯，應該把衣服洗(一)洗 (✗ 把衣服洗).
Negatives and "don't" go BEFORE 把: 別把這件事告訴他; 我沒把書拿給小美; 你不可以把房子賣了.

grammar.point: 把 O V了 — get O done
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + 了
grammar.explain: 把 O V了 stresses that the object gets 'dealt with/finished': 把碗洗了 (get the dishes washed). The verb in a 把 sentence can't stand alone — it needs 了, a result, a direction, etc.

examples.id: Please wash the dishes.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 27
note: 把 O V了 = the object gets dealt with completely: 病人把藥吃了; 李先生把房子賣了.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 32
note: A number of times or a part of the object can also complete the verb: 她把生詞寫了三遍才睡覺; 她把身上的衣服脫了一件 (took off one of her layers).

grammar.point: 把 O V在 + place — put … at …
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + 在 + place
grammar.explain: To say a thing is MOVED/PUT somewhere, Mandarin uses 把: 把沙發放在客廳 (not 放沙發在客廳 ✗).

examples.zh: 我們把沙發放在客廳吧。
examples.id: Let's put the sofa in the living room.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 27, 29
note: After 把 + object the verb cannot stand alone; it needs 在/到 + place, 給 + person, 了, or a result complement: ✓ 把書放在桌子上。 ✗ 把書放。
The object of 把 is a specific, known thing: 這張桌子、我的書.
Negation and prohibition go BEFORE 把: 別把書放在椅子底下。 我沒把他的書拿來。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 32
note: 把 + O + V + 了 + number of times: 她把生詞寫了三遍 (wrote the new words three times).
把 + O + V + 了 + part of O: 他把衣服脫了一件 (took off one of his layers).

grammar.point: 把 O V到 + place + 來/去 — move … to …
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + 到 + place + (來/去)
grammar.explain: V到 + place = arrive at the destination; 來/去 shows the direction relative to the speaker: 把櫃子搬到臥室去 (carry it to the bedroom, away), 把它放到桌子上來 (put it on the table here).

examples.id: Carry the cupboard to the bedroom.

options: 把那張椅子拿到這裡來。
拿到這裡來把那張椅子。
把那張椅子到這裡拿來。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 28–29
note: Direction of movement: V + 進/出/上/下/回/過 + 來/去: 把桌子搬進來、把書拿出來、把箱子搬上去. 來 = towards the speaker, 去 = away from the speaker.
把 is also used with result complements: 把門關上、把燈打開、把外套脫下來.

core.note: The most common, standard word for "bedroom" — use this one. 主臥室 = master bedroom. In everyday talk people also often just say 房間.
Means the SAME as 臥室, but is less common and sounds more colloquial/traditional. Just recognise it when reading or listening; when speaking, use 臥室.

a woman giving money to her younger brother
a woman giving money to a friend

tasks.why: 給弟弟 → B. A and C: other people.

lines.zh: 你這個月的零用錢還有多少？
本來有五百塊，買書用了三百塊。
那你口袋裡還有兩百塊吧？
沒有，我剛才又給了弟弟一百塊。

tasks.question: 這位先生現在還有多少錢？
tasks.why: 500 − 300 (books) − 100 (brother) = 100 (needs calculating) → C. A: what he spent on books. B: the woman's wrong guess.

lines.zh: 你看到我的鑰匙了嗎？我找了很久了。
你剛才不是把鑰匙放在口袋裡了嗎？
口袋裡沒有啊……啊，在這裡！在我的書包裡。
你怎麼每次都要找這麼久？

tasks.question: 這位小姐的意思是什麼？
options: 這位先生每次都把鑰匙放在書包裡
這位先生把鑰匙給了她
這位先生常常找不到東西
tasks.why: 你怎麼每次都要找這麼久 = why does it take you so long to find things every time → he often has trouble finding his things. B is not mentioned. C is reversed: the key was not given to her. A is too literal: 每次 refers to the habit of searching for a long time, not to where he keeps the key.

younger sister giving a key to her older brother
older brother giving a letter to his younger sister

tasks.why: The door is locked AND the key is still in it → 門鎖著，鑰匙還在門上. A: the door is not open. C: the key is visible, not lost.

tasks.text: 出去以前，別忘了（　）門鎖好。
tasks.why: Pattern 把 + O + V + result: 把門鎖好 = lock the door properly. 給 = give/for; 被 = passive marker — neither fits 鎖好.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我這個月的零用錢只有三千塊，可是現在才十號，我就（1）。媽媽說，買東西以前要想一想，這個東西是不是一定要買。所以我（2）：每天只帶一百塊出去，別的錢都放在書桌的櫃子裡，然後（3），把鑰匙交給姊姊。昨天我很想買一件新衣服，可是口袋裡的錢（4），所以我就（5）。
tasks.why: (1) it is only the 10th, but more than half of the money is gone. (2) 想了一個辦法, then the plan is described. (3) the cabinet is locked and the key is left with her sister. (4) the money in her pocket is 不夠. (5) 就回家了. 「把錢都放在口袋裡」 contradicts the text (the money is kept in the cabinet).

tasks.instr: Read this message, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 志明：我明天早上去臺中，星期五晚上才回來。我已經把家裡的鑰匙放在你的信箱裡了。這幾天請你每天去我家一次，打開我的信箱，把信拿出來放在我的書桌上。廚房的垃圾我已經拿出去了。謝謝你！——大文
tasks.question: 大文為什麼把鑰匙放在志明的信箱裡？
tasks.why: The key is left so that 志明 can get in and 把信拿出來放在書桌上. B is not mentioned in the note. C is reversed: 大文 is the one going to Taichung. A: the rubbish 已經拿出去了.

grammar.point: 把 O V + result — get O …
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + result (乾淨/完/錯…)
grammar.explain: 把 is often paired with the result of an action: 把房間弄乾淨 (get the room clean), 把錢用完 (use up the money). The result shows a change to the object.

examples.id: Have you cleaned your room?
I've spent all my money.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 29–31
note: 把 + O + V + direction/result: 請你把窗戶關上; 我想把外套脫下來; 請把燈開開; 請把這盤菜拿走.
The "can/can't" form (得/不) is NOT used with 把: ✗ 把圓桌搬不進去 → ✓ 圓桌搬不進去.

grammar.point: 把 N1 V給 N2 — give N1 to N2
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + thing + V給 + person
grammar.explain: The thing changing hands goes after 把, the recipient after V給: 把鑰匙交給你, 把信拿給我, 把錢寄給我.

examples.id: I'll hand the key to you.
My mum will send me some money.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 27
note: 把 + thing + V給 + person: 護士把藥拿給病人; 他把房子賣給張小姐. For telling something: 把 + matter + 說給 + person + 聽: 醫生把這件事情說給病人聽 (= 告訴病人).

tes_kata.zh: 我沒有（　），不能開門。
tes_kata.id: I don't have a key, so I can't open the door.

tes_kata.zh: 媽媽每個星期給我一百塊（　）。
tes_kata.id: Mum gives me a hundred dollars of pocket money every week.

modules.title: 浴室裡放著毛巾和牙刷。
modules.title_py: Yù shì lǐ fàng zhe máo jīn hé yá shuā.
modules.title_id: There are towels and toothbrushes in the bathroom.
modules.scene: Dawen and Zhiming are running out of bathroom supplies. They make a list of what to buy, then go shopping for daily necessities at the supermarket.
can_do: Express existence with 'place + V著 + thing' (浴室裡放著毛巾)
Express two simultaneous actions: V著 + V (笑著說)
Name toiletries: 牙膏、肥皂、洗髮精、衛生紙
modules.exam_link: Describing a picture with 'at … there is …' (PW + V著) is a key pattern in 閱讀 Parts 1–2 and 聽力 Part 1.

lines.zh: 大文，浴室裡沒有牙膏了！
lines.py: Dà wén, yù shì lǐ méi yǒu yá gāo le!
lines.id: Dawen, there's no toothpaste left in the bathroom!

lines.zh: 肥皂也用完了。廁所的衛生紙呢？
lines.py: Féi zào yě yòng wán le. Cè suǒ de wèi shēng zhǐ ne?
lines.id: The soap's used up too. What about the toilet paper?

lines.zh: 只有一包了。我們去超市買日用品吧。
lines.py: Zhǐ yǒu yì bāo le. Wǒ men qù chāo shì mǎi rì yòng pǐn ba.
lines.id: There's only one pack left. Let's go buy some daily necessities at the supermarket.

lines.zh: 好。浴室裡放著兩條毛巾、一個牙刷，毛巾夠了。
lines.py: Hǎo. Yù shì lǐ fàng zhe liǎng tiáo máo jīn, yí ge yá shuā, máo jīn gòu le.
lines.id: OK. There are two towels and one toothbrush in the bathroom — we have enough towels.

lines.zh: 洗髮精和沐浴乳也不多了。
lines.py: Xǐ fà jīng hàn mù yù rǔ yě bù duō le.
lines.id: There isn't much shampoo or body wash left either.

lines.zh: 你看，那邊站著很多人，他們在買什麼？
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, nà biān zhàn zhe hěn duō rén, tā men zài mǎi shén me?
lines.id: Look, there are lots of people standing over there — what are they buying?

lines.zh: 洗髮精今天比較便宜！我們買兩瓶。
lines.py: Xǐ fà jīng jīn tiān bǐ jiào pián yi! Wǒ men mǎi liǎng píng.
lines.id: Shampoo is cheaper today! Let's buy two bottles.

lines.zh: 好。我也要買一個新的牙刷。
lines.py: Hǎo. Wǒ yě yào mǎi yí ge xīn de yá shuā.
lines.id: OK. I want to buy a new toothbrush too.

lines.zh: 東西都買了。我拿著東西，你去付錢吧。
lines.py: Dōng xi dōu mǎi le. Wǒ ná zhe dōng xi, nǐ qù fù qián ba.
lines.id: We've bought everything. I'll hold the stuff, you go pay.

lines.zh: 你要去超市嗎？幫我買一瓶洗髮精。
好。你還要別的嗎？
衛生紙也沒有了。牙膏我昨天買了。
好，那我買洗髮精和衛生紙。

tasks.question: 這位小姐要買什麼？
tasks.why: 洗髮精 + 衛生紙; 牙膏我昨天買了 → C. A and B: the toothpaste was bought yesterday.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 我們去超市吧，家裡的日用品都用完了。
我昨天看了，浴室裡還放著一瓶洗髮精。
那是我的，你的上個星期就用完了。
真的嗎？那我們現在就去吧。

options: 這位小姐的洗髮精用完了
tasks.why: The shampoo there is hers; his 上個星期就用完了. C is reversed. A and B are not mentioned.

tasks.why: 放著一支牙刷 + 沒有牙膏 → only a toothbrush. B adds toothpaste; C is the opposite.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.

picture.label: an empty toilet-paper holder

tasks.text: 廁所裡沒有（　）了，你去買一包吧。
tasks.why: The toilet paper has run out; the measure word 一包 fits 衛生紙. 毛巾 takes 條 and 牙刷 takes 支.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 星期天我跟室友去超市買日用品。我們的浴室裡只（1），牙膏、肥皂都用完了。室友說：「衛生紙（2）？」我說：「上個星期剛買，還有很多。」我們買了牙膏、肥皂和一瓶洗髮精。回家的路上，室友（3）：「今天買的東西真便宜！」到了家，我們把東西都（4）。現在浴室裡（5），看起來舒服多了。
tasks.why: (1) only towels, everything else has run out. (2) offers to buy toilet paper. (3) 笑著說 = says with a smile (happy it was cheap). (4) the things go in the bathroom. (5) now there are lots of new things. 「站著一個人」 does not fit the story.

tasks.instr: Read this shopping list, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我上個月搬到新宿舍。房間不大，可是有自己的浴室。浴室的門後邊掛著兩條毛巾，桌子上放著牙刷、牙膏和洗髮精。第一天晚上我想洗澡，才發現沒有肥皂，也沒有沐浴乳。我就去樓下的商店買了一瓶沐浴乳。
tasks.question: 這個人第一天晚上為什麼去商店？
tasks.why: No soap or body wash → bought 沐浴乳 (for showering). A and C are already in the bathroom. B is not mentioned.

grammar.point: PW + V著 + N — at … there is … (existence)
grammar.explain: To describe what is at a place, the place goes FIRST, then V著 (how the thing is there), then the thing: 門口站著一個人 (at the door there's someone standing). More vivid than just 有.

examples.zh: 浴室裡放著毛巾和牙刷。
examples.id: There are towels and toothbrushes in the bathroom.
There's someone standing at the door.

check.q: 'There's a photo hanging on the door' =

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 32
note: More examples: 桌上放著一個杯子 (a cup is sitting on the table); 餐廳裡坐著不少客人 (quite a few guests are sitting in the restaurant).

grammar.point: V1著 + V2 — do V2 while V1-ing
grammar.explain: V著 before another verb expresses the manner/state while doing the main action: 笑著說 (to say with a smile), 坐著看書 (to read sitting down).

examples.zh: 房東笑著說：「你們的浴室很乾淨！」
examples.id: The landlord said with a smile.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 32
note: Two sentences become one: 他們坐著。他們在聊天。→ 他們坐著聊天. More: 站著聽音樂、躺著看書、笑著講手機、哭著找媽媽.

modules.title: 我兩天沒睡覺了！
modules.title_py: Wǒ liǎng tiān méi shuì jiào le!
modules.title_id: I haven't slept for two days!
modules.scene: For two nights in a row Dawen hasn't slept in his bed because of homework and exam revision; this morning Zhiming finds him asleep at his desk. At school Meimei sees how tired he is, and Dawen promises to go to bed early.
can_do: Say 'not yet' with 還沒(有)
Say 'haven't … for (a length of time)': 兩天沒睡覺了
Talk about sleep: 鬧鐘、枕頭、夢、上床、半夜
modules.exam_link: 還沒 (not yet) vs 沒 (didn't) and negative duration sentences are often tested in 聽力 Parts 2–3.

lines.zh: 大文，快起床！八點了！你在桌子上睡覺？
lines.py: Dà wén, kuài qǐ chuáng! Bā diǎn le! Nǐ zài zhuō zi shàng shuì jiào?
lines.id: Dawen, get up! It's eight o'clock! Did you sleep at your desk?

lines.zh: 啊！我寫功課寫到半夜，就在桌子上睡覺了，沒聽見鬧鐘！
lines.py: A! Wǒ xiě gōng kè xiě dào bàn yè, jiù zài zhuō zi shàng shuì jiào le, méi tīng jiàn nào zhōng!
lines.id: Oh no! I did homework until midnight, fell asleep at my desk, and didn't hear the alarm!

lines.zh: 九點上課，八點半要出門，快一點！
lines.py: Jiǔ diǎn shàng kè, bā diǎn bàn yào chū mén, kuài yì diǎn!
lines.id: Class is at nine and you have to leave at eight thirty—hurry up!

lines.zh: 你這一週每天都很晚睡覺。夜晚都在做什麼？
lines.py: Nǐ zhè yì zhōu měi tiān dōu hěn wǎn shuì jiào. Yè wǎn dōu zài zuò shén me?
lines.id: You've gone to bed late every day this week. What are you doing at night?

lines.zh: 寫功課，準備考試。前天晚上我也沒上床……
lines.py: Xiě gōng kè, zhǔn bèi kǎo shì. Qián tiān wǎn shàng wǒ yě méi shàng chuáng……
lines.id: Homework and studying for the exam. The night before last I didn't go to bed either…

lines.zh: 大文，你怎麼了？好像很累。
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ zěn me le? Hǎo xiàng hěn lèi.
lines.id: Dawen, what's wrong? You look really tired.

lines.zh: 我兩天沒睡覺了！前天沒上床，昨天也是在桌子上睡覺的，還做了一個夢。
lines.py: Wǒ liǎng tiān méi shuì jiào le! Qián tiān méi shàng chuáng, zuó tiān yě shì zài zhuō zi shàng shuì jiào de, hái zuò le yí ge mèng.
lines.id: I haven't slept for two days! The night before last I didn't go to bed, and last night I slept at my desk again—and I had a dream.

lines.zh: 夢見什麼？
lines.py: Mèng jiàn shén me?
lines.id: What did you dream about?

lines.zh: 夢見考試！時鐘上已經兩點了，我還沒寫完。
lines.py: Mèng jiàn kǎo shì! Shí zhōng shàng yǐ jīng liǎng diǎn le, wǒ hái méi xiě wán.
lines.id: The exam! The clock already said two, and I still hadn't finished writing.

lines.zh: 你太累了。今天晚上早點睡覺吧。
lines.py: Nǐ tài lèi le. Jīn tiān wǎn shàng zǎo diǎn shuì jiào ba.
lines.id: You're too tired. Go to bed early tonight.

lines.zh: 好，今天十點我就上床！我很想我的枕頭！
lines.py: Hǎo, jīn tiān shí diǎn wǒ jiù shàng chuáng! Wǒ hěn xiǎng wǒ de zhěn tou!
lines.id: OK, I'm going to bed at ten tonight! I miss my pillow!

grammar.point: duration + 沒 + V + 了 — haven't … for …

grammar.explain: For 'haven't … for (a period)', the duration goes BEFORE 沒: 我兩天沒睡覺了, 她半年沒回家了. (Unlike positive sentences, where the duration goes after the verb — B10.)

modules.title: 鄰居吵死了！
modules.title_py: Lín jū chǎo sǐ le!
modules.title_id: The neighbours are so noisy!
modules.scene: Dawen's neighbors sing every night and the mosquitoes never stop. Dawen and Zhiming decide to talk to the neighbors; the next day Dawen tells Meimei how it went.
can_do: Complain with extreme expressions: Vs死了 (吵死了、累死了)
Express non-stop actions: V個不停
Talk about neighbours & daily life
modules.exam_link: Spoken emotional expressions (…死了、…個不停) often appear in 聽力 Parts 3–4 to judge the speaker's attitude.

lines.zh: 志明，鄰居又在唱歌了，吵死了！
lines.py: Zhì míng, lín jū yòu zài chàng gē le, chǎo sǐ le!
lines.id: Zhiming, the neighbors are singing again — it's so noisy!

lines.zh: 對，他們每天晚上都唱個不停。
lines.py: Duì, tā men měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu chàng ge bù tíng.
lines.id: Yes, they sing nonstop every night.

lines.zh: 我明天有考試，想早點睡覺。
lines.py: Wǒ míng tiān yǒu kǎo shì, xiǎng zǎo diǎn shuì jiào.
lines.id: I have an exam tomorrow, I want to go to bed early.

lines.zh: 房間裡還有蚊子，飛個不停，我也累死了。
lines.py: Fáng jiān lǐ hái yǒu wén zi, fēi ge bù tíng, wǒ yě lèi sǐ le.
lines.id: There are mosquitoes in the room too, flying around nonstop. I'm exhausted too.

lines.zh: 我們去跟鄰居說一下吧。
lines.py: Wǒ men qù gēn lín jū shuō yí xià ba.
lines.id: Let's go talk to the neighbors.

lines.zh: 大文，你今天看起來還是很累。
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ jīn tiān kàn qǐ lái hái shì hěn lèi.
lines.id: Dawen, you still look tired today.

lines.zh: 對！這幾天，我每天都很晚才睡覺。
lines.py: Duì! Zhè jǐ tiān, wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn wǎn cái shuì jiào.
lines.id: Yes! These past few days I've been going to bed very late.

lines.zh: 為什麼？
lines.py: Wèi shén me?
lines.id: Why?

lines.zh: 鄰居每天晚上唱歌，房間裡的蚊子也多死了。我的日子太難過了！
lines.py: Lín jū měi tiān wǎn shàng chàng gē, fáng jiān lǐ de wén zi yě duō sǐ le. Wǒ de rì zi tài nán guò le!
lines.id: The neighbors sing every night, and there are tons of mosquitoes in my room. My life is so hard!

lines.zh: 你跟鄰居說了嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ gēn lín jū shuō le ma?
lines.id: Did you talk to the neighbors?

lines.zh: 說了。他們說十點以後不唱了。今天晚上我可以早點睡覺了！
lines.py: Shuō le. Tā men shuō shí diǎn yǐ hòu bú chàng le. Jīn tiān wǎn shàng wǒ kě yǐ zǎo diǎn shuì jiào le!
lines.id: I did. They said they won't sing after ten. Tonight I can go to bed early!

grammar.explain: 死了 after an adjective = extremely (spoken, emotional): 吵死了, 累死了, 熱死了, 高興死了. It has nothing to do with 'dying'.

grammar.explain: V個不停 (or V個沒完) = to keep doing something, often with a complaining tone: 唱個不停, 說個不停, 叫個不停.

modules.title: 鄉下沒有城市那麼方便。
modules.title_py: Xiāng xià méi yǒu chéng shì nà me fāng biàn.
modules.title_id: The countryside isn't as convenient as the city.
modules.scene: Dawen can't decide where to live next year: downtown or out in the countryside. He and Meimei compare life in the city and the countryside, including the countryside in Indonesia.
can_do: Make negative comparisons: A 沒有 B (那麼) + adjective
Say 'much more': 比…Vs得多
Talk about the environment & life: 鄉下、市區、環境、生活
modules.exam_link: Comparisons (沒有…那麼…、…得多) are a core pattern of 閱讀 Part 5 (light opinion essays) and 聽力 Part 4.

lines.zh: 大文，明年你要住在市區還是鄉下？
lines.py: Dà wén, míng nián nǐ yào zhù zài shì qū hái shì xiāng xià?
lines.id: Dawen, next year do you want to live downtown or in the countryside?

lines.zh: 我還不知道。市區的房屋太貴了，鄉下比市區便宜得多。
lines.py: Wǒ hái bù zhī dào. Shì qū de fáng wū tài guì le, xiāng xià bǐ shì qū pián yi de duō.
lines.id: I don't know yet. Houses downtown are too expensive, the countryside is much cheaper.

lines.zh: 可是鄉下沒有市區那麼方便。
lines.py: Kě shì xiāng xià méi yǒu shì qū nà me fāng biàn.
lines.id: But the countryside isn't as convenient as downtown.

lines.zh: 對，可是鄉下的環境好，夏天也涼快得多。
lines.py: Duì, kě shì xiāng xià de huán jìng hǎo, xià tiān yě liáng kuài de duō.
lines.id: True, but the environment in the countryside is nice, and it's much cooler in summer.

lines.zh: 我一直住在城市，很喜歡城市的生活。
lines.py: Wǒ yì zhí zhù zài chéng shì, hěn xǐ huān chéng shì de shēng huó.
lines.id: I've always lived in the city, and I really like city life.

lines.zh: 我小時候常常去印尼的鄉下，在奶奶家住。我比較喜歡那樣的生活。
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎo shí hòu cháng cháng qù Yìn ní de xiāng xià, zài nǎi nǎi jiā zhù. Wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huān nà yàng de shēng huó.
lines.id: When I was little I often went to the countryside in Indonesia and stayed at my grandma's. I prefer that kind of life.

lines.zh: 印尼的鄉下跟臺灣的鄉下不同嗎？
lines.py: Yìn ní de xiāng xià gēn Tái wān de xiāng xià bù tóng ma?
lines.id: Is the countryside in Indonesia different from the countryside in Taiwan?

lines.zh: 很不同。印尼的鄉下沒有臺灣這麼冷！
lines.py: Hěn bù tóng. Yìn ní de xiāng xià méi yǒu Tái wān zhè me lěng!
lines.id: Very different. The countryside in Indonesia isn't as cold as Taiwan!

lines.zh: 那你就住鄉下吧！週末我去找你，也過過這樣的生活。
lines.py: Nà nǐ jiù zhù xiāng xià ba! Zhōu mò wǒ qù zhǎo nǐ, yě guò guò zhè yàng de shēng huó.
lines.id: Then live in the countryside! I'll come visit you on weekends and try out this kind of life too.

tasks.text: 城市比鄉下方便（　）。
tasks.why: 比 + Vs + 得多 → B. A: 那麼 goes with 沒有. C: 不同 is not a complement.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我家以前在鄉下，後來搬到了市區。市區的生活（1），走路就可以到學校和超市。可是市區的房屋（2），我們家只能租一個小房子。夏天市區比鄉下（3），我常常想到鄉下的院子。爸爸說：「以後我們再搬回鄉下，過（4）。」我也覺得鄉下的環境（5）。
tasks.why: (1) the city is much more convenient. (2) city housing costs more → can only rent a small place. (3) the city is hotter → misses the country yard. (4) go back to life as it was. (5) the country environment is better. 「一點也不方便」 contradicts (1) and does not fit 環境.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 很多年輕人覺得城市的生活比鄉下好得多，因為工作多，買東西也方便。可是我在臺北住了五年，覺得城市的房屋太貴，環境也沒有鄉下那麼好。去年我搬到花蓮的鄉下，現在去市區要開車一個小時，可是每天都能看到山和海，我覺得這樣的生活很好。
tasks.question: 這個人覺得鄉下的生活怎麼樣？
options: 不太方便，可是他很喜歡
tasks.why: It takes an hour to get to town (less convenient), but 這樣的生活很好. B is the opposite. C: housing is expensive in the city. A: the jobs are in the city.

grammar.point: A 沒有 B (那麼/這麼) Vs — A isn't as … as B
grammar.pattern: A + 沒有 + B + (那麼) + Vs
grammar.explain: The negative form of comparison: A 沒有 B 那麼 Vs = A isn't as Vs as B (B is more Vs). 不比 is not used for this meaning.

examples.zh: 鄉下沒有城市那麼方便。
examples.id: The countryside isn't as convenient as the city.
Indonesia isn't as cold as Taiwan.

check.q: 'My younger brother isn't as tall as me' =

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 24
note: From 比 to 沒有: 我比李先生高 → 李先生沒有我(這麼)高. 這麼 = "this …" (near the speaker), 那麼 = "that …". 不像 also works: 李先生不像我這麼高.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 7
note: A 比不上 B / A 不如 B = A is not as good as B: 傳統火車的速度比不上高鐵的速度.

grammar.pattern: A + 比 + B + Vs + 得多
grammar.explain: 得多 after an adjective = much more: 冷得多, 好得多. It can be used without 比 if what is compared is clear. Don't use 很 (比印尼很冷 ✗).

examples.zh: 臺灣的冬天比印尼冷得多。
examples.id: Taiwan's winters are much colder than Indonesia's.

check.q: 'The train is much faster than the bus' =

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 24
note: The difference goes at the END: 貴得多 / 貴多了 (much more), 貴一點 (a bit more), 貴五千塊 (5,000 more), 輕兩公斤.
✗ 她的頭髮比我的很長 → ✓ 她的頭髮比我的長(得多).

modules.scene: Near the end of the month Dawen is eating only steamed buns because his monthly allowance is running out. Meimei looks at his spending diary and suggests they cook together.
can_do: Express gradual change: 越來越 + adjective
Say 'the more …, the more …': 越 A 越 B
Talk about spending: 生活費、花錢、一般、經常
modules.exam_link: 越來越／越…越… are a favourite pattern in 閱讀 Part 5 (essays about money & lifestyle) and 聽力 Part 4.

dialogs.title_id: End of the month, on campus

lines.zh: 大文，你怎麼每天都吃饅頭？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ zěn me měi tiān dōu chī mán tóu?
lines.id: Dawen, why are you eating steamed buns every day?

lines.zh: 到月底了，我的生活費不夠了。
lines.py: Dào yuè dǐ le, wǒ de shēng huó fèi bú gòu le.
lines.id: It's the end of the month, and my living expenses aren't enough.

lines.zh: 你一個月花多少錢？
lines.py: Nǐ yí ge yuè huā duō shǎo qián?
lines.id: How much do you spend a month?

lines.zh: 一般是一萬五。可是東西越來越貴了！
lines.py: Yì bān shì yí wàn wǔ. Kě shì dōng xi yuè lái yuè guì le!
lines.id: Usually fifteen thousand. But things are getting more and more expensive!

lines.zh: 加上房租呢？
lines.py: Jiā shàng fáng zū ne?
lines.id: What about with rent?

lines.zh: 兩萬多。我經常在日記裡寫我花了多少錢，你看。
lines.py: Liǎng wàn duō. Wǒ jīng cháng zài rì jì lǐ xiě wǒ huā le duō shǎo qián, nǐ kàn.
lines.id: Over twenty thousand. I often write down what I spend in my diary — look.

lines.zh: 咖啡、電影、衣服……你越買越多！
lines.py: Kā fēi, diàn yǐng, yī fú…… Nǐ yuè mǎi yuè duō!
lines.id: Coffee, movies, clothes… the more you buy, the more you buy!

lines.zh: 對，錢越來越少。
lines.py: Duì, qián yuè lái yuè shǎo.
lines.id: Yes, my money keeps getting less and less.

lines.zh: 下個月我們一起做飯吧，比較便宜。
lines.py: Xià ge yuè wǒ men yì qǐ zuò fàn ba, bǐ jiào pián yi.
lines.id: Next month let's cook together, it's cheaper.

lines.zh: 好！下個月我也不買咖啡了。
lines.py: Hǎo! Xià ge yuè wǒ yě bù mǎi kā fēi le.
lines.id: OK! Next month I won't buy coffee anymore either.

tasks.why: 越來越 + Vs + 了 → C. A: 越 must come in a pair (越…越). B: 經常 is not used with 多了.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 上大學以後，我一個人住在臺北。臺灣的東西（1），我的生活費常常不夠。媽媽說：「你應該（2），看一下錢都花在哪裡。」我寫了一個月才發現，我（3），每天都買咖啡。（4），一個月要花三千塊！現在我一般只喝水，（5），月底也還有錢。
tasks.why: (1) prices keep rising → not enough money. (2) keep a diary of spending. (3) drinking more and more. (4) with snacks, 3,000 a month. (5) result: more and more money. 「越來越便宜」 contradicts the money running short.

tasks.instr: Read this diary, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 小林每個月的生活費是一萬塊，加上他在咖啡店工作的錢，一共一萬三。他經常在日記裡寫他每天花了多少錢。上個月他發現，他花最多錢的地方不是吃飯，是買衣服，也越買越多。這個月他決定每個星期只去一次百貨公司，月底還有兩千塊。
tasks.question: 小林這個月為什麼還有錢？
tasks.why: He realised clothes were his biggest expense → shopped less → money left over. A is not mentioned. C is not mentioned (he did not stop eating). B: his café job existed before, so it is not the new reason.

grammar.point: 越來越 + Vs — more and more …
grammar.explain: 越來越 expresses an ongoing change: 越來越貴 (more and more expensive), 越來越冷. It doesn't take 很 (越來越很貴 ✗).

examples.zh: 臺灣的東西越來越貴了！
examples.id: Things in Taiwan are getting more and more expensive!

check.q: 'His Mandarin is getting better and better' =

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 34
note: Also for feelings and habits: 文英越來越愛吃包子了. 了 at the end is optional. 雨下得越來越大了 = 雨越下越大了.

grammar.point: 越 A 越 B — the more A, the more B
grammar.pattern: S + 越 + V/Vs + 越 + V/Vs
grammar.explain: Two things change together: 越吃越胖 (the more he eats, the fatter he gets), 越買越多. The subjects can differ: 你越說，我越不懂.

examples.id: The more I shop, the more I buy.

examples.zh: 我經常去夜市，越吃越胖！
examples.id: I go to the night market so often — the more I eat, the fatter I get!

check.q: 'The more I think about it, the angrier I get' =

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 34
note: Two different subjects: 房子離學校越近，房租就越貴 (就 may be added in the second part). One subject: 他的中文歌越唱越好.

modules.title_py: Chū mén bié wàng le dài sǎn!
modules.title_id: Don't forget your umbrella when you go out!
modules.scene: The teacher announces a class trip to the mountains and asks everyone to bring a raincoat and umbrella. The next morning it's cloudy, and Meimei reminds Dawen to take his umbrella.
can_do: Give polite instructions to a group: 請大家 + VP
Tell someone to stop: 別(再)…了 (別再走路了)
Talk about the weather: 陰天、晴天、溼、涼
modules.exam_link: Announcements by teachers/staff (請大家…) are classic material for 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Part 3; questions ask what to bring/do.

lines.zh: 同學們，明天我們去山上。山上很涼，請大家多穿一點衣服。
lines.py: Tóng xué men, míng tiān wǒ men qù shān shàng. Shān shàng hěn liáng, qǐng dà jiā duō chuān yì diǎn yī fú.
lines.id: Class, tomorrow we're going to the mountains. It's cool up there, so everyone please wear more clothes.

lines.zh: 老師，要帶傘嗎？
lines.py: Lǎo shī, yào dài sǎn ma?
lines.id: Teacher, do we need to bring an umbrella?

lines.zh: 要。山上的天氣常常變，晴天也會下雨。請大家帶雨衣和雨傘。
lines.py: Yào. Shān shàng de tiān qì cháng cháng biàn, qíng tiān yě huì xià yǔ. Qǐng dà jiā dài yǔ yī hàn yǔ sǎn.
lines.id: Yes. The weather in the mountains often changes — it can rain even on a sunny day. Everyone please bring a raincoat and an umbrella.

dialogs.place: 第二天早上，在大文家門口
dialogs.title_id: The next morning, outside Dawen's house

lines.zh: 大文，今天是陰天，別忘了帶傘！
lines.py: Dà wén, jīn tiān shì yīn tiān, bié wàng le dài sǎn!
lines.id: Dawen, it's cloudy today, don't forget your umbrella!

lines.zh: 好……啊，外面已經下雨了！
lines.py: Hǎo…… A, wài miàn yǐ jīng xià yǔ le!
lines.id: OK… oh, it's already raining outside!

lines.zh: 你的鞋子都溼了！別再走路了，我們坐車去學校吧。
lines.py: Nǐ de xié zi dōu shī le! Bié zài zǒu lù le, wǒ men zuò chē qù xué xiào ba.
lines.id: Your shoes are all wet! Don't walk anymore, let's take a ride to school.

lines.zh: 好。希望山上是晴天！
lines.py: Hǎo. Xī wàng shān shàng shì qíng tiān!
lines.id: OK. I hope it's sunny in the mountains!

tasks.text: 上個週末我跟朋友去山上玩。出門以前是晴天，所以我（1）。到了山上，天氣就變了，是（2），下午開始下大雨。我們的衣服和鞋子都（3）。山上又（4），我覺得很冷。朋友說：「（5），我們坐車回去吧。」
tasks.why: (1) sunny → no umbrella. (2) it turns cloudy. (3) soaked by the rain. (4) cold on the mountain. (5) stop walking, take a ride. 「請大家帶雨衣」 is the teacher's instruction and fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read this notice, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 各位同學：明天我們要去陽明山。山上的天氣常常變，早上是晴天，下午可能就下雨了。請大家帶雨衣，也請多帶一件衣服，因為山上比市區涼。早上八點在學校門口見，請大家早點到。中午我們在山上吃飯，請自己帶水。
tasks.question: 老師為什麼請大家多帶一件衣服？
tasks.why: 因為山上比市區涼 → that is the reason. A and B are reasons for the raincoat/umbrella, not the extra clothes. D is the opposite.

grammar.explain: In announcements or formal instructions, 請 + person + activity = 'please …': 請大家帶雨衣, 請多穿一點衣服.

examples.id: Please all bring a raincoat and an umbrella.

grammar.explain: 別…了 asks someone to STOP doing something they are doing/have done; 再 stresses 'any more'. 別忘了 = don't forget.

examples.zh: 別再走路了，我們坐車吧。
examples.id: Stop walking — let's take a bus.
Don't forget your umbrella when you go out!

modules.title: 我是在雅加達出生的，也在雅加達長大。
modules.title_py: Wǒ shì zài Yǎ jiā dá chū shēng de, yě zài Yǎ jiā dá zhǎng dà.
modules.title_id: I was born in Jakarta and also grew up in Jakarta.
modules.scene: Annie is interviewed for a scholarship: she talks about where she was born, her mother tongue, when she moved to Taipei, her schooling, and her trip to mainland China as a child.
can_do: Tell your life story: 出生、長大、上國小/中學
Say 'when …': …的時候
Put a story in order with 然後
modules.exam_link: Life stories & interviews appear in 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Part 4 (first-person narrative paragraphs).

lines.zh: 請你介紹一下自己。
lines.py: Qǐng nǐ jiè shào yí xià zì jǐ.
lines.id: Please introduce yourself.

lines.zh: 我叫安妮，今年二十一歲，是大學生。我是在雅加達出生的。
lines.py: Wǒ jiào Ān nī, jīn nián èr shí yī suì, shì dà xué shēng. Wǒ shì zài Yǎ jiā dá chū shēng de.
lines.id: My name is Annie, I'm twenty-one this year, and I'm a college student. I was born in Jakarta.

lines.zh: 你的母語是什麼？
lines.py: Nǐ de mǔ yǔ shì shén me?
lines.id: What's your mother tongue?

lines.zh: 印尼話。我家是華人，所以我也會說一點中文。
lines.py: Yìn ní huà. Wǒ jiā shì huá rén, suǒ yǐ wǒ yě huì shuō yì diǎn Zhōng wén.
lines.id: Indonesian. My family is ethnic Chinese, so I can also speak a little Chinese.

lines.zh: 你是什麼時候來臺灣的？
lines.py: Nǐ shì shén me shí hòu lái Tái wān de?
lines.id: When did you come to Taiwan?

lines.zh: 去年。我在雅加達長大，在那裡上國小和中學。
lines.py: Qù nián. Wǒ zài Yǎ jiā dá zhǎng dà, zài nà lǐ shàng guó xiǎo hàn zhōng xué.
lines.id: Last year. I grew up in Jakarta and went to elementary and secondary school there.

lines.zh: 你去過大陸嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ qù guò dà lù ma?
lines.id: Have you been to mainland China?

lines.zh: 去過一次。當時我年紀很小，只有八歲。
lines.py: Qù guò yí cì. Dāng shí wǒ nián jì hěn xiǎo, zhǐ yǒu bā suì.
lines.id: Once. I was very young at the time, only eight.

lines.zh: 好。請寫一下你的住址和電話。
lines.py: Hǎo. Qǐng xiě yí xià nǐ de zhù zhǐ hàn diàn huà.
lines.id: Good. Please write down your address and phone number.

lines.zh: 好。我的住址是臺北市大學路一百號。
lines.py: Hǎo. Wǒ de zhù zhǐ shì Tái běi shì dà xué lù yì bǎi hào.
lines.id: Sure. My address is No. 100, Daxue Road, Taipei.

對，我爸爸媽媽都是華人，可是我是在美國長大的。
那你怎麼說得這麼好？
我小的時候，爸媽在家只跟我說中文。

tasks.question: 這位小姐的中文為什麼說得很好？
tasks.why: 爸媽在家只跟我說中文 → that is the reason. A is wrong: she grew up in America. C and B are not mentioned.

tasks.why: 爺爺小時候的照片 + 才五歲 → A. B: now, not then. C: too young.

tasks.why: 在醫院出生 → C. A: 年紀 is a noun. B: you do not grow up only in a hospital.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我是在泗水出生的，我的（1）是印尼話。我十歲的時候，爸爸到臺北工作，我們就（2）。（3）我一句中文也不會說，上國小的時候，同學說什麼我都聽不懂。然後我每天放學以後都去學中文，（4），我的中文越來越好。現在我是（5），在臺北念書。
tasks.why: (1) mother tongue. (2) moved to Taiwan. (3) 當時 = at that time. (4) after starting middle school it improved. (5) now a university student. 「在大陸出生」 contradicts the text: she was born in Surabaya.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 陳先生是在印尼出生的華人。他的母語是印尼話，可是他爸爸媽媽在家都說中文。他上中學的時候，全家搬到臺灣，然後他在臺北上大學。當時他的中文不太好，上課很辛苦。現在他已經在臺灣住了二十年了，他說：「臺北就是我的第二個家。」
tasks.question: 陳先生覺得臺北怎麼樣？
tasks.why: 臺北就是我的第二個家 → like his own home. B describes the PAST (當時). C is not mentioned. D is not his opinion of Taipei.

grammar.explain: …的時候 = when …, placed AFTER the event (unlike English 'when' at the front). 當 can be added in front in written style.

examples.zh: 我上國小的時候，才來臺灣。
examples.id: I only came to Taiwan when I was at primary school.

examples.zh: 她八歲的時候，家人帶她來臺灣。
examples.id: When she was eight, her family brought her to Taiwan.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 21
note: Examples: 早上七、八點的時候，坐地鐵的人很多; 吃飯的時候，最好不要說話.
Three time markers: …以前 = before, …的時候 = while/when, …以後 = after.

grammar.explain: 然後 links events in sequence in a story. It is often paired with 先 (先…然後…). It is also used to ask for the rest of a story: 然後呢？

examples.id: Then I went to secondary school in Taipei.
And then?

check.q: Putting things in order: 'I eat first, then sleep.'

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 20
note: 然後 is often inserted between 先 and 再: 你先告訴我，(然後)我再告訴他.

modules.title: 我外婆有好幾個孫子。
modules.title_py: Wǒ wài pó yǒu hǎo jǐ ge sūn zi.
modules.title_id: My grandmother (on my mother's side) has quite a few grandchildren.
modules.scene: Meimei shows a photo of her big family at Chinese New Year. Dawen asks who everyone is: her maternal grandparents and her aunts and uncles on her father's side, and then they compare their families.
can_do: Say 'quite a few' with 好幾／好多 + measure word
Pick 'among them' with 其中
Name extended family members: 外公、外婆、姑姑、伯父、伯母、孫子
modules.exam_link: Extended-family terms appear in 閱讀 Parts 4–5; questions often ask you to count or identify relationships (其中…).

lines.zh: 大文，你看，這是我小時候，我們家過年的照片。
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ kàn, zhè shì wǒ xiǎo shí hòu, wǒ men jiā guò nián de zhào piàn.
lines.id: Dawen, look, this is a photo of my family at Chinese New Year when I was little.

lines.zh: 好多人！他們都是你的家人嗎？
lines.py: Hǎo duō rén! Tā men dōu shì nǐ de jiā rén ma?
lines.id: So many people! Are they all your family?

lines.zh: 對，一共有好幾十個人。
lines.py: Duì, yí gòng yǒu hǎo jǐ shí ge rén.
lines.id: Yes, there are several dozen people altogether.

lines.zh: 中間的老先生是誰？
lines.py: Zhōng jiān de lǎo xiān shēng shì shéi?
lines.id: Who's the old man in the middle?

lines.zh: 是我外公，旁邊是我外婆。他們有好幾個孫子和孫女，其中我是最大的。
lines.py: Shì wǒ wài gōng, páng biān shì wǒ wài pó. Tā men yǒu hǎo jǐ ge sūn zi hàn sūn nǚ, qí zhōng wǒ shì zuì dà de.
lines.id: That's my grandpa on my mom's side, and next to him is my grandma. They have quite a few grandsons and granddaughters, and I'm the oldest of them.

lines.zh: 這兩位呢？
lines.py: Zhè liǎng wèi ne?
lines.id: What about these two?

lines.zh: 是我伯父和伯母。伯父是我爸爸的哥哥，伯母是他的太太。
lines.py: Shì wǒ bó fù hàn bó mǔ. Bó fù shì wǒ bà ba dī gē ge, bó mǔ shì tā de tài tài.
lines.id: That's my uncle and aunt. My uncle is my dad's older brother, and my aunt is his wife.

lines.zh: 這位是你姑姑嗎？
lines.py: Zhè wèi shì nǐ gū gū ma?
lines.id: Is this your aunt on your dad's side?

lines.zh: 對，她是我爸爸的妹妹。爸爸的姊姊，我們叫她「姑媽」。
lines.py: Duì, tā shì wǒ bà ba de mèi mèi. Bà ba de jiě jie, wǒ men jiào tā "Gū mā".
lines.id: Yes, she's my dad's younger sister. My dad's older sister we call "gūmā".

lines.zh: 你有兄弟嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ yǒu xiōng dì ma?
lines.id: Do you have any brothers?

lines.zh: 我只有一個弟弟，他叫小明。你呢？
lines.py: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yí ge dì di, tā jiào Xiǎo míng. Nǐ ne?
lines.id: I only have one younger brother, his name is Xiaoming. What about you?

lines.zh: 我有一個哥哥和一個姊姊。我們家的人沒有你們家那麼多！
lines.py: Wǒ yǒu yí ge gē ge hàn yí ge jiě jie. Wǒ men jiā de rén méi yǒu nǐ men jiā nà me duō!
lines.id: I have one older brother and one older sister. My family isn't as big as yours!

tasks.instr: Listen to the short exchange, then choose the matching picture.

tasks.why: 爸爸的妹妹 → A. B: mother's side. C: that is 伯父, not 姑姑.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 這張照片裡的人都是你的家人嗎？
對，這是我外公外婆，旁邊是他們的孫子。
好多人啊！哪一個是你？
最左邊的，其中我年紀最大。

tasks.question: 哪一個是對的？
options: 這位先生是外公外婆的孩子
這位先生是外公外婆年紀最大的孫子
tasks.why: 他們的孫子…其中我年紀最大 → the eldest grandchild. A contradicts 好多人. B: he is a grandchild, not a child. C is not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 外婆坐在中間，旁邊站著好幾個孫子。
tasks.why: 外婆坐在中間 + 好幾個孫子 → A. B: no grandchildren. C: a grandfather with one grandchild.

picture.label: a big family together at New Year

options: 過年的時候，我家有好多人。
tasks.why: A big family → 好多人 → C. A and B: the opposite.

picture.label: father and his older brother

tasks.text: 爸爸的哥哥，我叫他（　）。
tasks.why: 爸爸的哥哥 = 伯父 → B. A: 姑姑 = father's sister. C: 外公 = mother's father.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我爸爸有三個兄弟，他是（1）。我的伯父住在美國，（2）他們一家人才回臺灣一次。我的姑姑很喜歡孩子，每次來我家都（3）。媽媽說，姑姑（4），叫她姑媽也可以。我覺得我家（5），過年的時候大家都很高興。
tasks.why: (1) dad is the youngest of them. (2) only comes back once every few years. (3) always brings lots of things. (4) 姑姑 = dad's younger sister (same as 姑媽). (5) a big family, everyone happy at New Year. 「有好幾個孫女」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 過年的時候，我們全家都去外婆家。外公外婆有三個孩子，其中我媽媽最小。外公外婆一共有七個孫子和孫女，其中只有我是女生。大家都很喜歡我，外婆每年都給我最多的紅包。
tasks.question: 哪一個是對的？
options: 她媽媽是外公外婆的大女兒
tasks.why: 其中只有我是女生 → the only granddaughter. B is the opposite (媽媽最小). C: seven is the number of grandchildren; there are three children. A contradicts it: she is the only girl.

grammar.point: 好 + 幾/多/些 + 量 — quite a few
grammar.explain: 好 before 幾/多/些 stresses that the number feels large: 好幾個孫子, 好多人, 好些朋友.

examples.id: My grandma has quite a few grandchildren.
My home is really lively!

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 21
note: 好幾 + measure = quite a lot: 他胖了好幾公斤 = 胖了很多公斤. 好多 = 很多.

grammar.explain: 其中 refers back to the group just mentioned: 有十個，其中三個是日本人 (there are ten, three of whom are Japanese).

examples.id: I'm the youngest of them.

check.q: Choose the right word: 我有五個朋友，＿＿兩個是臺灣人。

modules.title: 我姊姊快要結婚了！
modules.title_py: Wǒ jiě jie kuài yào jié hūn le!
modules.title_id: My sister is getting married soon!
modules.scene: Dawen announces that his older sister is going to marry her college classmate. Next week he's going home to Indonesia, and even his elderly grandmother is coming.
can_do: Say 'soon' with 快要…了 and 就要…了
Talk about marriage & family: 結婚、父母、父親、母親
Give a name with 叫做 and the number of family members with 口
modules.exam_link: Life events (marriage, moving, births) SOMETIMES appear in 聽力 Part 2 and 閱讀 Part 4. 快要…了 matters for the order of events.

lines.zh: 美美，我姊姊快要結婚了！
lines.py: Měi měi, wǒ jiě jie kuài yào jié hūn le!
lines.id: Meimei, my older sister is getting married soon!

lines.zh: 真的嗎？什麼時候？
lines.py: Zhēn de ma? Shén me shí hòu?
lines.id: Really? When?

lines.zh: 十二月十號。下個星期，我就要回印尼了。
lines.py: Shí èr yuè shí hào. Xià ge xīng qī, wǒ jiù yào huí Yìn ní le.
lines.id: December tenth. Next week I'm going back to Indonesia.

lines.zh: 你姊姊的先生是誰？
lines.py: Nǐ jiě jie de xiān shēng shì shéi?
lines.id: Who's your sister's husband?

lines.zh: 他叫做小林，是我姊姊大學的同班同學。
lines.py: Tā jiào zuò Xiǎo lín, shì wǒ jiě jie dà xué de tóng bān tóng xué.
lines.id: His name is Xiaolin, he was my sister's college classmate.

lines.zh: 他帥不帥？
lines.py: Tā shuài bú shuài?
lines.id: Is he handsome?

lines.zh: 很帥！我父母也很喜歡他。
lines.py: Hěn shuài! Wǒ fù mǔ yě hěn xǐ huān tā.
lines.id: Very handsome! My parents like him a lot too.

lines.zh: 你家有幾口人？
lines.py: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
lines.id: How many people are in your family?

lines.zh: 五口人：父親、母親、哥哥、姊姊和我。
lines.py: Wǔ kǒu rén: fù qīn, mǔ qīn, gē ge, jiě jie hàn wǒ.
lines.id: Five: my father, my mother, my older brother, my older sister, and me.

lines.zh: 你外婆也會來嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ wài pó yě huì lái ma?
lines.id: Is your grandma coming too?

lines.zh: 會！她已經是八十歲的老太太了，可是她說：「孫女結婚，我一定要去！」
lines.py: Huì! Tā yǐ jīng shì bā shí suì de lǎo tài tài le, kě shì tā shuō: "Sūn nǚ jié hūn, wǒ yí dìng yào qù!"
lines.id: Yes! She's an old lady of eighty now, but she said: "My granddaughter is getting married — I'm definitely going!"

lines.zh: 太好了！回來以後，給我看結婚的照片吧！
lines.py: Tài hǎo le! Huí lái yǐ hòu, gěi wǒ kàn jié hūn de zhào piàn ba!
lines.id: That's wonderful! When you come back, show me the wedding photos!

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我姊姊（1）了，她的先生是她大學的（2）。他很（3），也對姊姊很好。我們家一共有五（4），加上他就是六個人了。下個星期我們（5），大家都很忙。
tasks.why: (1) 快要結婚了. (2) university classmates. (3) handsome. (4) 五口人 = five family members. (5) 就要…了 with a time: going home next week. 「叫做老太太」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 小林和美美是大學的同班同學，今年十二月就要結婚了。小林的父母住在高雄，美美的父母住在臺北，所以他們要回兩個地方跟家人吃飯。美美說，她母親已經開始準備了，每天都很忙；她父親很少說話，可是晚上常常一個人看她小時候的照片。
tasks.question: 美美的父親為什麼常常看她小時候的照片？
options: 他在找結婚要用的照片
女兒快要結婚了，他有點難過
tasks.why: Quietly looking at childhood photos of the daughter who is about to marry → sad to 'let her go'. A and D are not mentioned. C: the house in 高雄 belongs to 小林's family, not his.

grammar.point: 就要…了 — (with a time) about to …
grammar.pattern: S + time + 就要 + V + 了
grammar.explain: 就要…了 = about to, and it CAN be preceded by a specific time expression: 三天以後就要回印尼了.

examples.zh: 三天以後，我們就要回印尼了。
examples.id: In three days we're going back to Indonesia.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 35
note: With a time expression, only 就(要)…了 is used: 下個禮拜就(要)開學了; 飛機三十分鐘以後就要起飛了. ✗ 下個禮拜快要開學了.

grammar.explain: 快要…了 = soon (hasn't happened yet). It CANNOT be preceded by a specific time (明天快要… ✗) — use 就要 for that.

examples.id: My sister is getting married soon!
The train's about to leave.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 35

modules.title_id: To get more pocket money, I work part-time.
modules.scene: Dawen is busy with a part-time job at a coffee shop. He and Meimei talk about why they work and what they want to be; this Saturday Dawen has to cover for a coworker, so Meimei comes to his shop.
can_do: Express a purpose with 為了 (為了…，我…)
Do something instead of/for someone else: 替
Talk about part-time work & professions: 打工、工人、商人、教書

lines.zh: 你打工的目的只是錢嗎？

lines.zh: 也是為了練習中文。來喝咖啡的客人都是臺灣人。
lines.py: Yě shì wèi le liàn xí Zhōng wén. Lái hē kā fēi de kè rén dōu shì Tái wān rén.
lines.id: It's also to practice Chinese. The customers who come for coffee are all Taiwanese.

lines.zh: 真好！你以後想做什麼？

lines.zh: 我爸爸是商人，我外公以前是工人。爸爸希望我也當商人，可是我想當中文老師。你呢？
lines.py: Wǒ bà ba shì shāng rén, wǒ wài gōng yǐ qián shì gōng rén. Bà ba xī wàng wǒ yě dāng shāng rén, kě shì wǒ xiǎng dāng Zhōng wén lǎo shī. Nǐ ne?
lines.id: My dad is a businessman, and my grandpa used to be a worker. Dad hopes I'll become a businessman too, but I want to be a Mandarin teacher. And you?

lines.zh: 我想教書。為了當老師，我每天都很用功。
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng jiào shū. Wèi le dāng lǎo shī, wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn yòng gōng.
lines.id: I want to teach. To become a teacher, I study hard every day.

lines.zh: 大文，今天一起去看電影吧！
lines.py: Dà wén, jīn tiān yì qǐ qù kàn diàn yǐng ba!

lines.zh: 對不起，今天我要替一個朋友上班，他生病了。
lines.py: Duì bù qǐ, jīn tiān wǒ yào tì yí ge péng yǒu shàng bān, tā shēng bìng le.
lines.id: Sorry, today I have to cover a shift for a friend — he's sick.

lines.zh: 好吧，那我去你的店裡喝咖啡！
lines.py: Hǎo ba, nà wǒ qù nǐ de diàn lǐ hē kā fēi!
lines.id: All right, then I'll come to your shop for a coffee!

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我爸爸是（1），常常去大陸工作。我媽媽在中學（2）。我上大學以後，（3），在一家餐廳打工。打工很累，可是我學到了很多。上個週末我生病了，我的同學（4）去餐廳工作。我打工的（5）不只是錢，也是為了多認識一些人。

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 很多大學生都在打工。有的人是為了生活費，有的人是為了多學一點東西。我的朋友小王在一家公司打工，他說打工的目的不是錢，是想知道自己以後想不想做那樣的工作。我在書店打工，因為我很喜歡看書，也可以替老闆介紹好書給客人。
tasks.question: 小王為什麼去公司打工？
options: 他想知道自己以後想做什麼工作
tasks.why: 目的不是錢，是想知道…想不想做那樣的工作 → that is the reason. A: he says it is not about money. C is the writer's reason, not 小王's. B is not mentioned.

grammar.point: 為了 — for the sake of / in order to
grammar.explain: 為了 introduces a PURPOSE, usually at the start of the sentence, followed by the action taken to achieve it. Different from 因為 (reason/cause).

examples.zh: 為了多一點零用錢，我去打工。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 18
note: 因為 + CAUSE (something that already happened); 為了 + PURPOSE (something you want to achieve).
Written style: 為了…而…: 何美麗為了研究中國方言而打算到中國住一年.

grammar.explain: 替 + person = to do something instead of or for that person: 替媽媽去市場 (go to the market instead of mum).

modules.title: 我今天必須加班。

modules.scene: Meimei invites Dawen to dinner, but Dawen, who's an intern, has to work overtime to finish a report for a meeting. The next day his boss praises the report and Dawen doesn't have to stay late, so he calls Meimei.
can_do: Express strong obligation with 必須
Say 'no need' with 不用／不必
Talk about office work: 加班、開會、報告、要求

lines.zh: 謝謝！還有問題嗎？
lines.py: Xiè xie! Hái yǒu wèn tí ma?
lines.id: Thank you! Are there any problems?

lines.zh: 沒有。公司的要求，你都做得很好。今天你不用加班了。
lines.py: Méi yǒu. Gōng sī de yāo qiú, nǐ dōu zuò de hěn hǎo. Jīn tiān nǐ bú yòng jiā bān le.

lines.zh: 太好了！明天還要開會嗎？

lines.zh: 不必，下個星期再開。
lines.py: Bú bì, xià ge xīng qī zài kāi.

lines.zh: 美美，今天我不用加班了！我們去吃飯吧！
lines.py: Měi měi, jīn tiān wǒ bú yòng jiā bān le! Wǒ men qù chī fàn ba!
lines.id: Meimei, I don't have to work overtime today! Let's go eat!

lines.zh: 好啊！我在學校門口等你。
lines.py: Hǎo a! Wǒ zài xué xiào mén kǒu děng nǐ.
lines.id: Sure! I'll wait for you at the school gate.

grammar.explain: 必須 = must, have to (stronger and more formal than 要). Its negative is NOT 不必須 but 不用 or 不必.

I have to finish the report.

grammar.explain: 不用 (spoken) and 不必 (a little formal) = there's no need. Also used as short answers: 不必。／不用了。

examples.id: You don't need to work overtime today.
No need.

check.q: The 'no need' answer to 我必須帶書嗎？

core.note: Means the SAME as 不用, slightly more formal. It is the negative of 必須 (✗ 不必須).
"No need" — the most common in conversation: 今天你不用加班了。

grammar.point: Vs極了／Vs得不得了／Vs得很 — extremely
grammar.pattern: Vs + 極了 ／ Vs + 得 + 不得了/很
grammar.explain: Three ways to intensify an adjective AFTER it: 有趣極了, 熱得不得了, 好玩得很 — all 'extremely'. Not used together with 很 in front (很有趣極了 ✗).

examples.id: This film's really fun!
Tomorrow will be extremely hot.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 22
note: The three forms are interchangeable: 他跑得快極了 = 快得很 = 快得不得了; 今天的比賽緊張極了 = 緊張得很 = 緊張得不得了.

grammar.explain: 不太 (more common) / 不很 = not very, a gentle way of giving a negative judgement. Compare: 很不好 (very bad) is much harsher.

examples.id: American films aren't very interesting.
Not much.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 19
note: 不太 + Vs = 不怎麼 + Vs: 小明家離博物館不太遠 = 不怎麼遠.

modules.title: 我們先去參觀，再去逛夜市。

modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei plan their day off: first the National Palace Museum, then the night market. At the night market they eat as they stroll and watch a street performance.
can_do: Put plans in order: 先…再…

Talk about sightseeing visits: 參觀、逛、訂、假日
modules.exam_link: Schedules & the order of activities (先…再…) often appear in 聽力 Part 3 ('what do they do first?') and 閱讀 Part 3.

tasks.instr: Read this plan, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 這個假日，我跟朋友在臺北玩。第一天我們先去參觀故宮，看了很多有名畫家的畫。晚上我們去逛夜市，一邊吃一邊逛，到處都是人。第二天我們想去爬山，可是下雨了，就在旅館休息了一天。
tasks.question: 他們第二天為什麼沒去爬山？
tasks.why: 可是下雨了 → bad weather. A is not mentioned. B and C were on the first day.

grammar.explain: 先 marks the first activity, 再 the next one (usually future plans). Different from 然後 (C12), which is more neutral, for telling stories.

examples.zh: 我們先去故宮參觀，再去逛夜市。
examples.id: Let's go to the Palace Museum first, then the night market.

note: Here 再 means 'and then', not 'again': 明年春天我打算先去義大利，再去法國.

modules.title: 搭捷運去比較快。
modules.title_py: Dā jié yùn qù bǐ jiào kuài.

modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei take the MRT to the department store: they go in through the entrance, wait on the crowded platform, and leave through the exit that leads right to the department store.

lines.zh: 搭捷運去比較快。
lines.py: Dā jié yùn qù bǐ jiào kuài.
lines.id: The MRT is faster.

lines.zh: 臺北的捷運跟雅加達的地鐵一樣嗎？
lines.py: Tái běi de jié yùn gēn Yǎ jiā dá de dì tiě yí yàng ma?

lines.zh: 差不多。走吧，入口在那邊。
lines.py: Chà bù duō. Zǒu ba, rù kǒu zài nà biān.
lines.id: More or less. Come on, the entrance is over there.

lines.zh: 月臺上人好多！
lines.py: Yuè tái shàng rén hǎo duō!
lines.id: There are so many people on the platform!

lines.zh: 沒關係，班次很多，五分鐘就有一班。

lines.zh: 車上有座位嗎？

lines.zh: 沒有，我們站著吧。
lines.py: Méi yǒu, wǒ men zhàn zhe ba.
lines.id: No, let's stand.

lines.zh: 還有幾站？
lines.py: Hái yǒu jǐ zhàn?
lines.id: How many more stops?

lines.zh: 快到了……到了！我們從三號出口出去，可以直接到百貨公司。
lines.py: Kuài dào le…… Dào le! Wǒ men cóng sān hào chū kǒu chū qù, kě yǐ zhí jiē dào bǎi huò gōng sī.

modules.title: 我騎不了機車。
modules.title_py: Wǒ qí bù liǎo jī chē.
modules.title_id: I can't ride a scooter.
modules.scene: Meimei teaches Dawen to ride a scooter like most people in Taiwan. Dawen is nervous because the traffic is chaotic, so they practice in a parking lot first.
can_do: Say whether you are able to: V得了／V不了
Say whether a result is possible: V得/不 + result (聽得懂、看不清楚)
Talk about traffic: 機車、停車場、公路、速度、交通
modules.exam_link: Potential forms (聽得懂/聽不懂、吃得了/吃不了) appear very often in 聽力 Parts 2–4 and are distractors in 閱讀 Part 4.

lines.zh: 大文，臺灣人都騎機車，你會騎嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, Tái wān rén dōu qí jī chē, nǐ huì qí ma?
lines.id: Dawen, everyone in Taiwan rides a scooter — can you ride one?

lines.zh: 不會。臺灣的交通太亂了，我騎不了機車。
lines.py: Bú huì. Tái wān de jiāo tōng tài luàn le, wǒ qí bù liǎo jī chē.
lines.id: No. Taiwan's traffic is too chaotic, I can't handle riding a scooter.

lines.zh: 沒關係，我教你。
lines.py: Méi guān xì, wǒ jiào nǐ.
lines.id: It's OK, I'll teach you.

lines.zh: 可是公路上的速度太快了。
lines.py: Kě shì gōng lù shàng de sù dù tài kuài le.
lines.id: But the speed on the highway is too fast.

lines.zh: 我們先在停車場練習。
lines.py: Wǒ men xiān zài tíng chē chǎng liàn xí.
lines.id: Let's practice in the parking lot first.

lines.zh: 你看，這是我的摩托車。你坐在這裡。
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, zhè shì wǒ de mó tuō chē. Nǐ zuò zài zhè lǐ.
lines.id: Look, this is my scooter. Sit here.

lines.zh: 好。騎完了，機車要停在哪裡？
lines.py: Hǎo. Qí wán le, jī chē yào tíng zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: OK. When I'm done riding, where should I park the scooter?

lines.zh: 要停在停車場，路邊不能停。
lines.py: Yào tíng zài tíng chē chǎng, lù biān bù néng tíng.
lines.id: You have to park in a parking lot — you can't park by the side of the road.

lines.zh: 你說得很清楚，我都聽得懂。你騎車也很標準！
lines.py: Nǐ shuō de hěn qīng chǔ, wǒ dōu tīng de dǒng. Nǐ qí chē yě hěn biāo zhǔn!
lines.id: You explained it really clearly, I understood everything. And you ride perfectly too!

lines.zh: 那你今天騎得了嗎？
lines.py: Nà nǐ jīn tiān qí de liǎo ma?
lines.id: So can you manage riding today?

lines.zh: 今天我騎自行車就好！希望明年能夠自己騎機車去學校。
lines.py: Jīn tiān wǒ qí zì xíng chē jiù hǎo! Xī wàng míng nián néng gòu zì jǐ qí jī chē qù xué xiào.
lines.id: I'll just ride a bicycle today! I hope next year I can ride a scooter to school by myself.

tasks.instr: Read this parking sign, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 在臺灣，很多人騎機車上班，因為機車很方便，停車也比較容易。可是公路上的機車太多了，速度也很快，交通常常很亂。我剛來臺灣的時候，一看到那麼多機車就很緊張。所以我買了一輛自行車，每天騎自行車去學校。自行車比較慢，可是我騎的時候一點也不緊張。

tasks.why: 看到機車就很緊張 + 騎自行車不緊張 → that is the reason. A and C are not mentioned. D is the opposite.

grammar.explain: 得了/不了 (liǎo) after a verb = able or unable (because of ability/circumstances): 騎不了 (can't ride), 吃得了嗎？ (can you finish it?).

examples.id: I can't ride a scooter.
With this much food, can you finish it?

check.q: 'I won't be able to come tomorrow' =

grammar.point: V得/不 + result — can/can't (achieve a result)
grammar.pattern: V + 得/不 + result (懂/清楚/到…)
grammar.explain: 得 or 不 is inserted between a verb and its result to express possibility: 聽得懂 (can understand), 看不清楚 (can't see clearly), 找不到 (can't find).

examples.id: I understand everything.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 30, 31
note: Asking: V得X V不X?: 這個蛋糕，你吃得完吃不完? / 這件襯衫洗得乾淨嗎?
Also with directions: 上得去 / 上不去, 搬得進去 / 搬不進去: 小貓上得去，小狗上不去.

supplement.meaning: can; to be able to (more formal than 能)

modules.title: 我明天才出國。
modules.title_py: Wǒ míng tiān cái chū guó.
modules.title_id: I'm not going abroad until tomorrow.
modules.scene: Dawen is getting ready to go home to Indonesia for his sister's wedding: he only just got his plane ticket and doesn't have enough suitcases, so Meimei lends him one. When he arrives in Indonesia he calls Meimei.
can_do: Say 'not until (later than expected)': 才1 (明天才出國)
Say 'only (a little)': 才4 (才一個小時)
Talk about international travel: 出國、簽證、行李、時差
modules.exam_link: 才 vs 就 (later vs earlier than expected) is one of the most frequent distractors in 聽力 Part 4.

lines.zh: 大文，你今天出國嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ jīn tiān chū guó ma?
lines.id: Dawen, are you leaving the country today?

lines.zh: 不，我明天才出國。飛機票昨天才拿到。
lines.py: Bù, wǒ míng tiān cái chū guó. Fēi jī piào zuó tiān cái ná dào.
lines.id: No, I only leave tomorrow. I just got my plane ticket yesterday.

lines.zh: 你要簽證嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ yào qiān zhèng ma?
lines.id: Do you need a visa?

lines.zh: 不用，我是印尼人，回印尼不需要簽證。
lines.py: Bú yòng, wǒ shì Yìn ní rén, huí Yìn ní bù xū yào qiān zhèng.
lines.id: No, I'm Indonesian—I don't need a visa to go home to Indonesia.

lines.zh: 行李準備了嗎？
lines.py: Xíng lǐ zhǔn bèi le ma?
lines.id: Have you packed your luggage?

lines.zh: 還沒。我才有一個箱子，不夠。
lines.py: Hái méi. Wǒ cái yǒu yí ge xiāng zi, bú gòu.
lines.id: Not yet. I only have one suitcase — it's not enough.

lines.zh: 我有一個大箱子，借給你吧！
lines.py: Wǒ yǒu yí ge dà xiāng zi, jiè gěi nǐ ba!
lines.id: I have a big suitcase — I'll lend it to you!

lines.zh: 太好了，謝謝！
lines.py: Tài hǎo le, xiè xie!
lines.id: Great, thanks!

lines.zh: 美美，我到印尼了！
lines.py: Měi měi, wǒ dào Yìn ní le!
lines.id: Meimei, I've arrived in Indonesia!

lines.zh: 好快！臺灣和印尼的時差是幾個小時？
lines.py: Hǎo kuài! Tái wān hàn Yìn ní de shí chà shì jǐ ge xiǎo shí?
lines.id: That was fast! What's the time difference between Taiwan and Indonesia?

lines.zh: 才一個小時。
lines.py: Cái yí ge xiǎo shí.
lines.id: Only one hour.

lines.zh: 你要在印尼留多久？
lines.py: Nǐ yào zài Yìn ní liú duō jiǔ?
lines.id: How long are you staying in Indonesia?

lines.zh: 留兩個星期。姊姊結婚以後，我就回臺灣。
lines.py: Liú liǎng ge xīng qī. Jiě jie jié hūn yǐ hòu, wǒ jiù huí Tái wān.
lines.id: Two weeks. After my sister's wedding, I'll come back to Taiwan.

tasks.text: 下個月我要去日本念書，（1），下個星期就要出國了。我要在日本（2），所以要帶很多行李。可是（3），不夠，還要再買一個。（4），所以（5）。

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 很多人第一次出國，只準備了簽證和行李，可是忘了時差的問題。我去年去美國念書，那裡跟臺灣的時差是十二個小時。第一個星期，我晚上兩點還不想睡覺，白天上課一直想睡覺。一個星期以後才好一點。
tasks.question: 這個人去美國第一個星期怎麼了？
options: 因為時差，白天很想睡覺
他每天晚上很早就睡覺
tasks.why: B 12-hour time difference → sleepy in the daytime. B: what was forgotten is the time difference, not the visa. C is not mentioned. D is the opposite (still not sleepy at 2 a.m.).

grammar.explain: 才 after a time expression = not until (late/later than hoped): 明天才出國, 半夜兩點才睡覺. Sentences with 才 usually DON'T use 了. The opposite: 就 (earlier).

examples.id: I'm not leaving until tomorrow.
I only got my visa yesterday.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 26
note: 才 = later than usual: 小明昨天十二點才睡. 就 = earlier than usual: 小華昨天十二點就睡了.
Fixed pairs: 才…的 and 就…了: 他們上個星期才認識的 / 他們很早以前就認識了.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 3
note: 才 (already happened, late) vs 再 (not yet happened, planned for later): 他今天十一點才到學校 / 他說他十一點再來上課.

grammar.explain: 才 before a number = only, stressing that the amount is small: 才一個小時, 我才有一個箱子.

examples.id: Only one hour.
I only have one suitcase.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 26
note: 才 + number = the speaker thinks it is SMALL/little: 現在才十點 (still early), 他才二十八歲 (still young), 這本書才一千塊錢 (cheap).
Amounts can also be judged with 就/才: 吃三碗麵就飽了 (three bowls = not many) vs 吃了兩碗麵才飽 (two bowls = a lot).

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 13
note: 而已 at the end stresses 'only': 她才來臺灣一個月而已. 不過(是)/只是…而已 = merely: 臺灣只是一個島而已.

grammar.point: 不管…都… — no matter what/how …, still …
grammar.pattern: 不管 + (question word/A不A)…，S + 都 + VP
grammar.explain: 不管 is followed by a question word (什麼/多/誰) or an A不A form, then 都 in the second clause: the outcome doesn't change under any condition.

examples.id: However we get there, I still want to go!
No matter how expensive they are, we'll buy them!

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 21–22
note: Three forms after 不管: (1) A 還是 B: 不管芒果還是鳳梨，臺灣人都很喜歡吃; (2) question word: 不管哪一個城市，都有很多便利商店; (3) A-not-A: 不管那支手機貴不貴，林芳芳都要買.
不管 is more spoken; 不論/無論 more formal. The second part always has 都 (also 都不 / 都沒).

grammar.point: 只好 — have no choice but to
grammar.explain: 只好 = there's no other option but …: 票賣完了，我們只好坐船. It is usually preceded by the reason.

modules.title: 要是颱風來了，就不去溫泉了。
modules.title_py: Yào shì tái fēng lái le, jiù bú qù wēn quán le.
modules.title_id: If the typhoon comes, we won't go to the hot spring.
modules.scene: Meimei suggests a trip to the hot springs in Beitou, but the news forecasts a typhoon. They make a conditional plan and keep watching the typhoon's path until Friday night.
can_do: Make hypotheses: 要是…就…、…的話
Understand weather news: 颱風、中心、方向、度
Talk about locations & estimates: 地點、大概
modules.exam_link: Typhoon news & conditional plans are a typically Taiwanese context in 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Part 5.

lines.zh: 大文，這個週末我們去北投的溫泉吧！
lines.py: Dà wén, zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ men qù Běi tóu de wēn quán ba!
lines.id: Dawen, let's go to the hot springs in Beitou this weekend!

lines.zh: 好啊！可是新聞說，週末大概會有颱風。
lines.py: Hǎo a! Kě shì xīn wén shuō, zhōu mò dà gài huì yǒu tái fēng.
lines.id: Sure! But the news says there will probably be a typhoon this weekend.

lines.zh: 真的嗎？颱風現在在哪裡？
lines.py: Zhēn de ma? Tái fēng xiàn zài zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Really? Where is the typhoon now?

lines.zh: 颱風的中心在臺灣的南方，方向是往北。
lines.py: Tái fēng de zhōng xīn zài Tái wān de nán fāng, fāng xiàng shì wǎng běi.
lines.id: The center of the typhoon is south of Taiwan, and it's heading north.

lines.zh: 要是颱風來了，我們就不去了。
lines.py: Yào shì tái fēng lái le, wǒ men jiù bú qù le.
lines.id: If the typhoon comes, we won't go.

lines.zh: 好，我們星期五晚上再看一次新聞。
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ men xīng qī wǔ wǎn shàng zài kàn yí cì xīn wén.
lines.id: OK, let's check the news again on Friday night.

lines.zh: 大文，你看新聞了嗎？颱風的方向變了！
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ kàn xīn wén le ma? Tái fēng de fāng xiàng biàn le!
lines.id: Dawen, have you seen the news? The typhoon has changed direction!

lines.zh: 看了！颱風往東走了，不會來臺北。
lines.py: Kàn le! Tái fēng wǎng dōng zǒu le, bú huì lái Tái běi.
lines.id: Yes! The typhoon has moved east, it won't come to Taipei.

lines.zh: 太好了！明天幾度？
lines.py: Tài hǎo le! Míng tiān jǐ dù?
lines.id: Great! How many degrees will it be tomorrow?

lines.zh: 大概二十度，不冷也不熱。溫泉的地點離捷運站遠嗎？
lines.py: Dà gài èr shí dù, bù lěng yě bú rè. Wēn quán de dì diǎn lí jié yùn zhàn yuǎn ma?
lines.id: About twenty degrees, not cold and not hot. Is the hot spring far from the MRT station?

lines.zh: 不遠，走路五分鐘。下雨的話，我們就坐計程車。
lines.py: Bù yuǎn, zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng. Xià yǔ de huà, wǒ men jiù zuò jì chéng chē.
lines.id: Not far, a five-minute walk. If it rains, we'll take a taxi.

lines.zh: 好！聽說冬天去溫泉最舒服，春季也不錯，可是我等不了了！
lines.py: Hǎo! Tīng shuō dōng tiān qù wēn quán zuì shū fu, chūn jì yě bú cuò, kě shì wǒ děng bù liǎo le!
lines.id: Great! They say hot springs are best in winter, and spring is nice too, but I can't wait!

grammar.explain: 要是 = if (more colloquial than 如果, B18). 就 marks the result in the second clause.

options: 要是你有空，我們就去看電影。
你要是有空就，我們去看電影。
就要是你有空，我們去看電影。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 4, 12
note: 要是 is more colloquial, 如果 a bit more formal; both can close with …的話: 要是明天天氣熱的話，我們就去游泳。
既然…，就… is for something ALREADY certain, not a supposition: 既然你不想去，我們就不去了。
只要…就… = as long as …, then …; 只有…才… = only if …, then …: 只要你有空，我們就去。 / 只有週末，我才有空。

grammar.explain: 的話 goes at the END of the condition: 下雨的話 = if it rains. It can be combined with 要是/如果: 要是下雨的話.

examples.zh: 下雨的話，我們大概就不去了。
examples.id: If it rains, we might not go.

tasks.text: 上個星期弟弟感冒了，後來我也感冒了。我一直咳嗽、流鼻水，晚上也常常頭痛。醫生給了我一些藥，說一天吃三次。可是第三天我找不到藥了，問了媽媽才知道，是被弟弟吃掉了，他以為那是他的藥。媽媽只好再帶我去看醫生。

grammar.point: 被 + (N) + V得 + effect — made … by …
grammar.pattern: S + 被 + N + V + 得 + effect
grammar.explain: The passive pattern with 得 stresses the EFFECT on the subject: 我被這個感冒弄得很累 (this flu has worn me out).

examples.zh: 我被這個感冒弄得很累。
examples.id: This flu has really worn me out.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 33
note: 被 is used when the subject UNDERGOES something, often unpleasant: 我的藥被弟弟吃掉了。 The doer can be left out if unknown: 我的腳踏車被偷了。
One event, three viewpoints: 弟弟吃了我的藥 (plain) · 我的藥被弟弟吃了 (被: focus on the medicine) · 弟弟把我的藥吃了 (把: focus on what the doer did).
As with 把, the verb after 被 cannot stand alone: 被…吃掉了、被…弄得很累.

grammar.explain: 掉 after a verb = something is used up/thrown away/lost through that action: 吃掉 (eaten up), 丟掉 (thrown away), 用掉 (used up).

examples.id: My little brother ate all my medicine!

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 31
note: 掉 is one of the result complements (V + result): 吃掉、丟掉、賣掉 = until gone. Other result complements: 吃完、吃飽、洗乾淨、看見、買到.
A result not reached is negated with 沒: 我沒吃完。 Able/unable to reach a result: V得/不 + result: 吃得完 / 吃不完。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 27
note: 一直 + V = continuously from some point until now: 我從昨天一直咳嗽。
Compare 一向 = has always been so (habit): 他一向不喜歡吃藥。

core.note: The standard verb for "to cough" — use it as the main form: 我一直咳嗽。 你咳嗽嗎？
Means the SAME as 咳嗽 (one-character form). Usually used when something follows it: 咳了一下、咳了兩聲. In a simple sentence use 咳嗽.

grammar.explain: 應該 also expresses a fairly confident estimate: 她應該在路上了 (she should be on the way by now), 三天以後應該就好了.

lines.zh: 我已經二十二歲了，不會再長高了。

lines.zh: 小狗都天天運動，我明天也要來散步。
lines.py: Xiǎo gǒu dōu tiān tiān yùn dòng, wǒ míng tiān yě yào lái sàn bù.

lines.zh: 你以前說你很忙，沒有時間運動！

lines.zh: 我才不覺得無聊呢！跟你一起走，很有意思。
lines.py: Wǒ cái bù jué de wú liáo ne! Gēn nǐ yì qǐ zǒu, hěn yǒu yì si.
lines.id: I don't think it's boring at all! Walking with you is fun.

tasks.text: 我每天在公司坐八個小時，回家以後還（1）。上個月我的背和腿都開始痛，就去看了醫生。醫生說：「你（2），身體才會好。」他還說，別一直低頭，因為這樣（3）。所以現在我每天下班以後先去公園走四十分鐘，（4）。一個月以後，背真的不痛了，（5）。
tasks.why: (1) a bad habit at home. (2) pattern 要…才: 要每天動一動，身體才會好. (3) the reason not to look down. (4) 先…再: walk first, then go home for dinner. (5) an extra good result. 「對身體特別好的」 ends in 的, so it cannot finish any sentence.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 很多人覺得，小孩子長得高不高，只跟爸爸媽媽的身高有關係。可是，吃得好、常常運動、晚上早點睡覺，也很重要。我弟弟小時候很瘦，也不高，可是他每天打籃球，晚上十點以前一定睡覺。現在他十八歲了，比爸爸還高一點。
tasks.question: 這個人想說什麼？
options: 身高不是只跟爸媽有關係
tasks.why: Main idea: 可是…也很重要 → height is not only about the parents. B is not mentioned. C: the text only says the brother is taller than the father, not that the father is tall. D over-generalises from one person.

grammar.explain: 才 marks that the result ONLY happens if the condition is met: 多運動，身體才會好 (you'll only be healthy if you exercise a lot). Compare 就: the condition is enough, the result follows easily.

examples.zh: 你要多運動，身體才會好。
examples.id: You have to exercise a lot to be healthy.

check.q: 'You have to study every day to pass the exam' =
options: 要每天念書，就才考得好。

grammar.explain: 才 also stresses an opinion, often contradicting someone: 我才不相信呢！ (I don't believe that at all!), 這才對 (now that's right).

examples.id: I don't believe that at all!
You're the one who should exercise more.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 今天早上我七點半才起床，一看時鐘就知道要遲到了。我立刻出門，可是路上車很多，結果到學校的時候已經八點二十了。老師正在上課，問了我一個問題，我才坐下，還沒聽清楚題目，就要回答。結果我答錯了，同學們都笑了。
tasks.question: 這個人為什麼答錯了？
tasks.why: 還沒聽清楚題目，就要回答 → the direct cause. A is why he was late, not why he was wrong. B is not mentioned. C happened AFTER he got it wrong.

grammar.explain: A rhetorical question to reproach or remind: 你不是說八點上課嗎？ = you said 8 o'clock, didn't you? (but that's not how it turned out). The meaning is positive, despite the 不.

examples.id: Didn't you say class is at eight?

grammar.point: 才…就… — only just …, and already …
grammar.explain: The second event happens very soon after the first, often unexpectedly: 我才出門，就八點了 (I'd only just left, and it was already eight).

examples.id: I've only just looked at it and my head's spinning!

lines.id: Are plane tickets back to Indonesia expensive?

lines.zh: 寒假的飛機票很貴。暑假比較長，我暑假再回家。
lines.py: Hán jià de fēi jī piào hěn guì. Shǔ jià bǐ jiào cháng, wǒ shǔ jià zài huí jiā.
lines.id: Plane tickets over winter break are expensive. Summer break is longer, so I'll go home in the summer.

lines.zh: 那寒假你要做什麼？
lines.py: Nà hán jià nǐ yào zuò shén me?
lines.id: So what will you do over winter break?

lines.zh: 我要打工，也要學中文。你放假的時候做什麼？
lines.py: Wǒ yào dǎ gōng, yě yào xué Zhōng wén. Nǐ fàng jià de shí hòu zuò shén me?
lines.id: I'm going to work part-time and study Chinese too. What do you do when you're on break?

lines.zh: 有時候在家看書，有時候跟朋友出去玩。寒假跟我去臺南玩，好不好？
lines.py: Yǒu shí hòu zài jiā kàn shū, yǒu shí hòu gēn péng yǒu chū qù wán. Hán jià gēn wǒ qù Tái nán wán, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.id: Sometimes I read at home, sometimes I go out with friends. Come to Tainan with me in the winter break—how about it?

lines.zh: 好啊！春假我們也可以去別的地方。
lines.py: Hǎo a! Chūn jià wǒ men yě kě yǐ qù bié de dì fāng.
lines.id: Sure! We could go somewhere else over spring break too.

lines.zh: 春假只有幾天，去近一點的地方吧。
lines.py: Chūn jià zhǐ yǒu jǐ tiān, qù jìn yì diǎn de dì fāng ba.
lines.id: Spring break is only a few days, so let's go somewhere closer.

modules.title: 從明年七月起，我就不是學生了！
modules.title_py: Cóng míng nián qī yuè qǐ, wǒ jiù bú shì xué shēng le!
modules.title_id: From July next year, I won't be a student anymore!
modules.scene: Dawen will graduate next June and wants to research Mandarin teaching for Indonesian students. Meimei encourages him to go and see Professor Lin.
can_do: Express a starting point: 從…起
Stress an identity/place with 就 (就是、就在)
Talk about graduation & further study: 畢業、研究、教授、程度
modules.exam_link: Study & career plans appear in 閱讀 Part 5 and 聽力 Part 4. 就是 is often a pointer to the answer ('that's the one').

lines.zh: 大文，你什麼時候畢業？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ shén me shí hòu bì yè?
lines.id: Dawen, when do you graduate?

lines.zh: 明年六月。從明年七月起，我就不是學生了！
lines.py: Míng nián liù yuè. Cóng míng nián qī yuè qǐ, wǒ jiù bú shì xué shēng le!
lines.id: Next June. Starting next July, I won't be a student anymore!

lines.zh: 畢業以後，你要做什麼？
lines.py: Bì yè yǐ hòu, nǐ yào zuò shén me?
lines.id: What are you going to do after you graduate?

lines.zh: 我想研究教育。
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng yán jiū jiào yù.
lines.id: I want to do research in education.

lines.zh: 研究什麼呢？
lines.py: Yán jiū shén me ne?
lines.id: Research on what?

lines.zh: 題目就是「印尼學生怎麼學中文」。
lines.py: Tí mù jiù shì "Yìn ní xué shēng zěn me xué Zhōng wén".
lines.id: The topic is "How Indonesian students learn Chinese."

lines.zh: 很有意思！你需要教授幫你嗎？
lines.py: Hěn yǒu yì si! Nǐ xū yào jiào shòu bāng nǐ ma?
lines.id: That's really interesting! Do you need a professor to help you?

lines.zh: 對。林教授說我的中文程度很高，我希望得到他的幫助。
lines.py: Duì. Lín jiào shòu shuō wǒ de Zhōng wén chéng dù hěn gāo, wǒ xī wàng dé dào tā de bāng zhù.
lines.id: Yes. Professor Lin says my Mandarin level is high; I hope to get his help.

lines.zh: 林教授的辦公室就在那邊，你現在去問他吧！
lines.py: Lín jiào shòu de bàn gōng shì jiù zài nà biān, nǐ xiàn zài qù wèn tā ba!
lines.id: Professor Lin's office is right over there—go and ask him now!

lines.zh: 好！從今天起，我每天看三個小時的書。我說了，就一定要做到！
lines.py: Hǎo! Cóng jīn tiān qǐ, wǒ měi tiān kàn sān ge xiǎo shí de shū. Wǒ shuō le, jiù yí dìng yào zuò dào!
lines.id: OK! Starting today, I'll study three hours every day. When I say I'll do something, I do it!

lines.zh: 你一定會成功！
lines.py: Nǐ yí dìng huì chéng gōng!
lines.id: You'll definitely succeed!
