modules.title: 漢字要多寫寫、看看。
modules.title_py: Hàn zì yào duō xiě xie, kàn kan.
modules.title_id: You have to write and look at Hanzi a lot.
modules.scene: Dawen often writes Chinese characters wrong and asks the teacher for tips. The teacher suggests a calligraphy class, so Dawen tries one with Meimei.
can_do: Try something with VV看 (試試看、寫寫看)
Soften suggestions with ABAB reduplication (休息休息)
Talk about strategies for learning Hanzi: 背、查、遍、拼音、書法
modules.exam_link: Study strategies appear in 閱讀 Part 5. Reduplicated verbs (VV看) often appear in 聽力 Parts 2–3 as gentle suggestions.

lines.zh: 陳老師，漢字很難，我常常寫錯。我怎麼學？
lines.py: Chén lǎo shī, hàn zì hěn nán, wǒ cháng cháng xiě cuò. Wǒ zěn me xué?
lines.id: Ms. Chen, Chinese characters are so hard, I often write them wrong. How should I learn them?

lines.zh: 每個詞寫十遍，多寫寫、看看，就記得了。
lines.py: Měi ge cí xiě shí biàn, duō xiě xiě, kàn kàn, jiù jì de le.
lines.id: Write each word ten times — write and look a lot, and you'll remember them.

lines.zh: 我可以只看拼音嗎？
lines.py: Wǒ kě yǐ zhǐ kàn pīn yīn ma?
lines.id: Can I just look at the pinyin?

lines.zh: 不行，拼音只能幫你念。不會的字，你可以查字典，試試看。你也可以去上書法課，寫書法對學漢字很有幫助。
lines.py: Bù xíng, pīn yīn zhǐ néng bāng nǐ niàn. Bú huì de zì, nǐ kě yǐ chá zì diǎn, shì shì kàn. Nǐ yě kě yǐ qù shàng shū fǎ kè, xiě shū fǎ duì xué hàn zì hěn yǒu bāng zhù.
lines.id: No, pinyin only helps you read aloud. For characters you don't know, try looking them up in a dictionary. You can also take a calligraphy class—writing calligraphy really helps with learning characters.

lines.zh: 大文，你想寫寫看書法嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ xiǎng xiě xiě kàn shū fǎ ma?
lines.id: Dawen, do you want to try writing calligraphy?

lines.zh: 好啊，我想試試看。這個字怎麼寫？我查一下。
lines.py: Hǎo a, wǒ xiǎng shì shì kàn. Zhè ge zì zěn me xiě? Wǒ chá yí xià.
lines.id: Sure, I'd like to try. How do you write this character? Let me look it up.

lines.zh: 慢慢寫……很好！
lines.py: Màn màn xiě…… Hěn hǎo!
lines.id: Write slowly… very good!

lines.zh: 寫了一個小時，好累，我們休息休息吧。
lines.py: Xiě le yí ge xiǎo shí, hǎo lèi, wǒ men xiū xí xiū xí ba.
lines.id: We've been writing for an hour, I'm so tired. Let's take a break.

lines.zh: 好。休息完了，你還要背二十個詞呢！
lines.py: Hǎo. Xiū xí wán le, nǐ hái yào bèi èr shí ge cí ne!
lines.id: OK. After the break, you still have to memorize twenty words!

lines.zh: 好！那我們等一下再練習練習。
lines.py: Hǎo! Nà wǒ men děng yí xià zài liàn xí liàn xí.
lines.id: OK! Then we'll practice some more later.

grammar.point: ABAB reduplication — doing something for a bit
grammar.pattern: AB + AB (休息休息、練習練習)
grammar.explain: Two-syllable verbs are repeated whole (ABAB) to make the action sound brief & relaxed: 休息休息 (take a little break), 練習練習. Not AABB (休休息息 ✗).

examples.id: Let's take a little break.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 33
note: VERBS repeat as ABAB: 休息休息、參觀參觀、練習練習. ADJECTIVES repeat as AABB: 熱熱鬧鬧、乾乾淨淨、漂漂亮亮.

grammar.explain: A one-syllable verb is repeated and 看 added = to try doing: 試試看 (give it a try), 吃吃看 (try eating), 寫寫看 (try writing).

grammar.point: 除了…以外，還/也… — besides …, also …
grammar.pattern: 除了 + A + (以外)，S + 還/也 + B
grammar.explain: With 還/也, 除了 means ADDING: besides A, B too. A is still included.

examples.zh: 除了中文以外，我還學歷史和法律。
examples.id: Besides Mandarin, I'm also studying history and law.

check.q: 除了咖啡以外，我也喝茶 means…

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 14
note: 除了…以外 + 還/也 = ADDING: 除了中文以外，方文英還會說西班牙語、法語和德語.
Either 除了 or 以外 alone is enough; 以外 can also be replaced by 之外.

grammar.pattern: 除了 + A + (以外)，(the rest) + 都 + VP
grammar.explain: With 都, 除了 means EXCLUDING: except A, all the others … (A is not included). Watch the word that follows: 還/也 (adding) vs 都 (excluding).

examples.zh: 除了大文以外，大家都去了。
examples.id: Everyone went except Dawen.

check.q: 除了星期天，我每天都上班 means…

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 14
note: 除了…以外 + 不/沒 = only that, nothing else: 謝心美只去過臺灣 → 除了臺灣以外，謝心美沒去過別的國家.

lines.zh: 你數數看。
lines.py: Nǐ shǔ shǔ kàn.

lines.zh: ……是四！
lines.py: …… Shì sì!
lines.id: …Four!

lines.zh: 對！你很認真，數學一定會越來越好。
lines.py: Duì! Nǐ hěn rèn zhēn, shù xué yí dìng huì yuè lái yuè hǎo.
lines.id: Right! You're hardworking — your math will definitely keep getting better.

lines.zh: 大文哥哥，你的中文為什麼這麼好？
lines.py: Dà wén gē ge, nǐ de Zhōng wén wèi shén me zhè me hǎo?
lines.id: Dawen, why is your Chinese so good?

lines.zh: 因為我也很認真！
lines.py: Yīn wèi wǒ yě hěn rèn zhēn!
lines.id: Because I'm hardworking too!

picture.label: studying seriously

tasks.text: 他寫作業很（　），一個字也沒寫錯。
tasks.why: 很 + 認真 → C. A: 困難 does not fit "not a single mistake". B: 數 is a verb.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我妹妹今年上國小，（1），每天都做數學作業。昨天她問我：「（2）是多少？」我說：「是四。」她又問：「（3）呢？」我說：「是九。」然後她（4），有十個。她說：「（5），我吃三個，還有七個！」
tasks.why: (1) she studies maths hard. (2) eight divided by two. (3) three times three. (4) counted the apples on the table. (5) ten minus three is seven. 「很困難的作業」 does not fit any gap.

tasks.instr: Read this homework, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我弟弟今年八歲，他覺得數學很困難，每次數學都只有六十分。我發現他不是不認真，是不喜歡數學。所以我叫他數家裡的東西，例如：桌子上有幾個蘋果，一個蘋果二十塊，一共多少錢。現在他覺得數學很有意思，上個月考了九十分。
tasks.question: 弟弟為什麼現在覺得數學有意思？
options: 哥哥用家裡的東西教他
tasks.why: 叫他數家裡的東西 → a new way that made him like it. A: he was serious from the start. B is the result, not the cause. C is not mentioned.

grammar.point: 四則運算 — the four arithmetic operations
grammar.pattern: A + 加/減/乘/除 + B + 是 + C
grammar.explain: 加 (plus), 減 (minus), 乘 (times), 除 (divided by; spoken 十二除四 = 12 ÷ 4). The result is introduced with 是.

grammar.pattern: whole number + 點 + digits (read one by one)
grammar.explain: The decimal point is read 點; the digits after it are read one by one: 3.14 = 三點一四. A leading zero: 零點五 (0.5).

supplement.meaning: difference; short of (十和四差六; 差一分 = one point short)

supplement.extra: used in the dialogue (Carli's review report 2026-11-04), not in the official TBCL list

modules.title: 三分之一的學生每天運動。
modules.title_py: Sān fēn zhī yī de xué shēng měi tiān yùn dòng.
modules.title_id: A third of the students exercise every day.
modules.scene: The teacher shares the results of a class survey on students' habits: exercise, coffee, and sleep. It turns out Dawen is one of those who don't sleep enough.
can_do: Say fractions: 三分之一
Say percentages: 百分之八十
Read the results of a simple survey: 許多、包括、一切、當中
modules.exam_link: Percentages & fractions appear in 閱讀 Part 5 (survey results, opinion essays) and 聽力 Part 4; questions often ask you to work out a part of a part.

lines.zh: 上個星期我問了我們班的同學一些問題。我們班有三十個學生，三分之一的學生每天運動。
lines.py: Shàng ge xīng qī wǒ wèn le wǒ men bān de tóng xué yì xiē wèn tí. Wǒ men bān yǒu sān shí ge xué shēng, sān fēn zhī yì de xué shēng měi tiān yùn dòng.
lines.id: Last week I asked our classmates some questions. There are thirty students in our class, and one third of them exercise every day.

lines.zh: 三分之一，那是十個學生！
lines.py: Sān fēn zhī yī, nà shì shí ge xué shēng!
lines.id: One third — that's ten students!

lines.zh: 對。還有，百分之八十的學生每天喝咖啡。
lines.py: Duì. Hái yǒu, bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de xué shēng měi tiān hē kā fēi.
lines.id: Right. Also, eighty percent of the students drink coffee every day.

lines.zh: 老師，這包括您嗎？
lines.py: Lǎo shī, zhè bāo kuò nín ma?
lines.id: Teacher, does that include you?

lines.zh: 不包括，都是學生說的。
lines.py: Bù bāo kuò, dōu shì xué shēng shuō de.
lines.id: No, these are all the students' answers.

lines.zh: 睡覺呢？
lines.py: Shuì jiào ne?
lines.id: What about sleep?

lines.zh: 許多同學說他們很忙，當中一半每天睡覺的時間只有六個小時。
lines.py: Xǔ duō tóng xué shuō tā men hěn máng, dāng zhōng yí bàn měi tiān shuì jiào de shí jiān zhǐ yǒu liù ge xiǎo shí.
lines.id: Many students say they're busy, and half of them sleep only six hours a day.

lines.zh: 大文，你也是那一半吧？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ yě shì nà yí bàn ba?
lines.id: Dawen, you're in that half too, aren't you?

lines.zh: 對……從今天起，我要早點睡覺！
lines.py: Duì…… Cóng jīn tiān qǐ, wǒ yào zǎo diǎn shuì jiào!
lines.id: Yes… starting today, I'm going to bed earlier!

lines.zh: 很好！大家要記得，健康比一切都重要。
lines.py: Hěn hǎo! Dà jiā yào jì de, jiàn kāng bǐ yí qiè dōu zhòng yào.
lines.id: Good! Remember, everyone: health is more important than anything.

tasks.text: 我們班有四十個學生。老師問大家喜歡不喜歡中文，結果（1），就是三十個人。（2），有十個人每天都看中文電影。老師說：「（3），都是因為你們很認真。」可是她也說，這個結果（4），因為她（5）。
tasks.why: (1) three-quarters said they like it. (2) of those thirty people. (3) all this. (4) does not include the teacher herself. (5) also really likes Chinese. 「百分之二十」 does not fit: 20% of 40 is not 30.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 學校問了三百個學生：「你每天睡覺的時間有多長？」結果，三分之一的學生每天睡覺的時間只有五個小時，當中許多人說是因為晚上要打工。百分之二十的學生說他們睡覺的時間夠。
tasks.question: 睡覺時間只有五個小時的學生，許多是因為什麼？
tasks.why: 當中許多人說是因為晚上要打工. A, C and B are not mentioned.

grammar.explain: Fractions are read from the DENOMINATOR first: 三分之一 = 1/3 (one of three parts), 四分之三 = 3/4. The opposite of the English order ('one third').

examples.zh: 三分之一的學生每天運動。
examples.id: A third of the students exercise every day.

grammar.explain: Per cent = 'out of a hundred parts': 百分之八十 = 80%, 百分之五 = 5%.

examples.zh: 百分之八十的學生喜歡喝咖啡。
examples.id: Eighty per cent of the students like coffee.

modules.title: 臺北的房租是雅加達的兩倍左右。
modules.title_py: Tái běi de fáng zū shì Yǎ jiā dá de liǎng bèi zuǒ yòu.
modules.title_id: Rent in Taipei is about twice as much as in Jakarta.
modules.scene: Dawen is looking for a cheaper place to live. He compares rent in Taipei and Jakarta, then looks at a place with Meimei that offers a discount for young students.
can_do: Express multiples: A 是 B 的 … 倍
Give estimates: number + 左右
Express limits: …以上／…以下
modules.exam_link: Multiples, ranges and age/price limits often appear in 閱讀 Part 3 (ticket price boards) and 聽力 Parts 3–4.

lines.zh: 美美，臺北的房租是雅加達的兩倍左右！
lines.py: Měi měi, Tái běi de fáng zū shì Yǎ jiā dá de liǎng bèi zuǒ yòu!
lines.id: Meimei, rent in Taipei is about twice as much as in Jakarta!

lines.zh: 真的嗎？你現在的房租多少？
lines.py: Zhēn de ma? Nǐ xiàn zài de fáng zū duō shǎo?
lines.id: Really? How much is your rent now?

lines.zh: 一萬塊左右。在雅加達，五千塊就夠了。
lines.py: Yí wàn kuài zuǒ yòu. Zài Yǎ jiā dá, wǔ qiān kuài jiù gòu le.
lines.id: About ten thousand. In Jakarta, five thousand would be enough.

lines.zh: 你想找多少錢的房子？
lines.py: Nǐ xiǎng zhǎo duō shǎo qián de fáng zi?
lines.id: How much do you want to pay for a place?

lines.zh: 八千塊以下的。
lines.py: Bā qiān kuài yǐ xià de.
lines.id: Under eight thousand.

lines.zh: 這個房子很好，可是房租九千塊以上。
lines.py: Zhè ge fáng zi hěn hǎo, kě shì fáng zū jiǔ qiān kuài yǐ shàng.
lines.id: This place is nice, but the rent is over nine thousand.

lines.zh: 太貴了！
lines.py: Tài guì le!
lines.id: Too expensive!

lines.zh: 你看，這裡寫著：二十五歲以下的學生，可以便宜一千五百塊。
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, zhè lǐ xiě zhe: èr shí wǔ suì yǐ xià de xué shēng, kě yǐ pián yi yì qiān wǔ bǎi kuài.
lines.id: Look, it says here: students under 25 get 1,500 off.

lines.zh: 我二十二歲！那就是七千五百塊左右。
lines.py: Wǒ èr shí èr suì! Nà jiù shì qī qiān wǔ bǎi kuài zuǒ yòu.
lines.id: I'm 22! So that's about 7,500.

lines.zh: 還有，這裡離學校很近，走路十分鐘左右。
lines.py: Hái yǒu, zhè lǐ lí xué xiào hěn jìn, zǒu lù shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu.
lines.id: And it's close to school here — about a ten-minute walk.

lines.zh: 好，就是這裡了！
lines.py: Hǎo, jiù shì zhè lǐ le!
lines.id: OK, this is the one!

tasks.text: 這個公園星期一休息，星期二到星期天早上九點到下午五點開門。票：大人一百塊。十二歲以下的小孩是大人的一半，六十五歲以上的老人不用錢。十個人以上一起來，每個人可以便宜二十塊。公園裡不能騎自行車，也不能帶狗進去。

grammar.point: 一 M 比一 M — more and more …
grammar.pattern: 一 + M + 比 + 一 + M + Vs
grammar.explain: Comparing one after another so that it feels like it's increasing: 一件比一件便宜 (each one cheaper than the last), 一天比一天冷 (colder day by day).

examples.zh: 這裡的衣服一件比一件便宜！
examples.id: The clothes here get cheaper and cheaper!

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 34
note: Close in meaning to 越來越 + Vs (more and more …): 天氣越來越熱了。 Pattern 越 V 越 Vs: 雨越下越大。

grammar.explain: Vs了一點 = a little more than you'd like (a mild complaint): 貴了一點 (a bit too expensive), 大了一點 (a bit too big). Compare 有點貴 (B20) and 貴一點 (B21, asking for a more … one).

examples.id: It's discounted, but still a bit too expensive.

check.q: 'The shoes are a bit too small' =

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 23–24

Compare with 比 + difference: 這雙比那雙大一點。

grammar.point: AA的 + N — reduplicated adjectives as modifiers
grammar.explain: A one-syllable adjective is repeated and + 的 to describe a noun vividly: 紅紅的毛衣 (a bright red sweater), 長長的頭髮. No 很.

examples.id: This red sweater is pretty.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 33
note: AA的 / AABB的 + noun: 長長的頭髮、香香甜甜的熱巧克力.

grammar.pattern: S + Vs Vs + 的 ／ S + AABB + 的
grammar.explain: Reduplication can also be the predicate (with 的 at the end): 皮鞋黑黑的 (the shoes are jet black), 房間乾乾淨淨的 (the room is spotless). No 很.

examples.id: These shoes are jet black.
The room is spotless.

modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei shop at a traditional market and stop at a fruit stand run by a shop owner who's famous for being friendly and has been in business for twenty years.
can_do: Say how something is done with 地 (高興地說)
Use reduplication as an adverbial (慢慢地、高高興興地)
Talk about doing business: 老闆娘、主人、做生意
modules.exam_link: Adverbials of manner (…地 + V) often appear in 閱讀 Part 4. The difference between 的/地/得 is one of the most classic grammar questions.

tasks.text: 我家樓下有一家小店，（1）是一位老太太。她已經在這裡（2）二十年了。她每天都（3）跟客人說話，大家都很喜歡她。我常常去她的店買水果，她常常送我一（4）水果。她常常說：「你（5）看，不用快。」
tasks.why: (1) the shop owner. (2) in business for 20 years. (3) AABB地 + V: talks cheerfully. (4) a basketful. (5) 慢慢地看 = take your time looking. 「好好的」 uses 的, but a manner adverb before a verb needs 地.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我家附近的市場有一家水果店，主人是一位老闆娘。她已經做了三十年的生意了。她說，做生意最重要的不是賣得多，是讓客人高高興興地回家。所以要是水果不好，她一定不賣。有一次我買的蘋果不甜，她就再給了我一籃子。
tasks.question: 老闆娘覺得做生意什麼最重要？
tasks.why: 最重要的不是賣得多，是讓客人高高興興地回家. A is directly denied. B and D are not mentioned.

grammar.explain: 地 (de) links an adverbial of MANNER to the verb: 高興地說 (to say happily), 慢慢地走. Remember the trio: 的 + noun, 地 + verb, V + 得 + result.

examples.zh: 她每天高高興興地做生意。
examples.id: She does business cheerfully every day.

check.q: Choose the right word: 他很認真＿學中文。

grammar.explain: An adjective is repeated (慢慢, 好好, 高高興興) and + 地 to describe vividly how something is done: 你慢慢地看 (take your time looking), 好好地吃飯.

examples.id: Take your time and have a look.
Eat properly!

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 33

modules.title: 這件太小了，可以換一換嗎？
modules.title_py: Zhè jiàn tài xiǎo le, kě yǐ huàn yí huàn ma?
modules.title_id: This one's too small — can I exchange it?
modules.scene: The sweater Dawen bought yesterday is too small. He exchanges it at the shop and picks a trendy color; then at home Zhiming compliments his new sweater.
can_do: Politely ask to exchange something: V一V (換一換)
Say you are used to something: V慣 (住慣了、吃不慣)
Talk about colours & trends: 深、淺、流行
modules.exam_link: V慣 (to be used to) appears in 閱讀 Part 5 (stories of international students adapting) and 聽力 Part 4.

lines.zh: 小姐，我昨天在這裡買了這件毛衣，可是太小了。可以換一換嗎？
lines.py: Xiǎo jiě, wǒ zuó tiān zài zhè lǐ mǎi le zhè jiàn máo yī, kě shì tài xiǎo le. Kě yǐ huàn yí huàn ma?
lines.id: Excuse me, I bought this sweater here yesterday, but it's too small. Could I exchange it?

lines.zh: 我看一看……可以。你要大一點的嗎？
lines.py: Wǒ kàn yí kàn…… Kě yǐ. Nǐ yào dà yì diǎn de ma?
lines.id: Let me take a look… Sure. Would you like a bigger one?

lines.zh: 對。這個顏色太深了，有沒有淺一點的？
lines.py: Duì. Zhè ge yán sè tài shēn le, yǒu méi yǒu qiǎn yì diǎn de?
lines.id: Yes. This color is too dark—do you have a lighter one?

lines.zh: 有，這件淺藍色的現在很流行。你試穿看看吧。
lines.py: Yǒu, zhè jiàn qiǎn lán sè de xiàn zài hěn liú xíng. Nǐ shì chuān kàn kàn ba.
lines.id: Yes, this light blue one is very popular now. Try it on.

lines.zh: 剛好！前面這個圓圓的口袋也很特別。
lines.py: Gāng hǎo! Qián miàn zhè ge yuán yuán de kǒu dài yě hěn tè bié.
lines.id: It fits! The round pocket on the front is nice and unusual too.

lines.zh: 你的中文說得很好。你在臺灣住慣了嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ de Zhōng wén shuō de hěn hǎo. Nǐ zài Tái wān zhù guàn le ma?
lines.id: Your Chinese is very good. Are you used to living in Taiwan?

lines.zh: 住慣了，也吃慣了。可是這裡衣服的大小，我還不習慣，常常買錯。
lines.py: Zhù guàn le, yě chī guàn le. Kě shì zhè lǐ yī fú de dà xiǎo, wǒ hái bù xí guàn, cháng cháng mǎi cuò.
lines.id: I'm used to living here, and to the food too. But I'm still not used to the clothing sizes here—I often buy the wrong size.

lines.zh: 沒關係，買錯了可以來換。我們六點鐘關門。
lines.py: Méi guān xì, mǎi cuò le kě yǐ lái huàn. Wǒ men liù diǎn zhōng guān mén.
lines.id: No problem, if you buy the wrong one you can come and exchange it. We close at six o'clock.

lines.zh: 大文，你的新毛衣很好看！
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ de xīn máo yī hěn hǎo kàn!
lines.id: Dawen, your new sweater looks great!

lines.zh: 昨天買的太小了，今天我去換了，顏色也換了。
lines.py: Zuó tiān mǎi de tài xiǎo le, jīn tiān wǒ qù huàn le, yán sè yě huàn le.
lines.id: The one I bought yesterday was too small, so today I exchanged it and changed the color too.

lines.zh: 淺藍色很適合你，現在很流行。
lines.py: Qiǎn lán sè hěn shì hé nǐ, xiàn zài hěn liú xíng.
lines.id: Light blue really suits you—it's very popular now.

tasks.text: 上個星期我買了一件毛衣，回家以後發現太小了，所以今天（1）。店員說：「你要什麼顏色的？」我說：「（2），（3）。」店員說：「（4）。」我（5），覺得不錯，就買了。現在我天天都穿這件毛衣，已經穿慣了。

tasks.instr: Read these shop rules, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我剛來臺灣的時候，吃不慣這裡的菜，也住不慣小小的房間。天氣又熱又溼，我常常想回家。可是住了半年以後，我慢慢住慣了，也交了很多朋友。現在我最喜歡臺灣的小吃，回印尼的時候，我還會想吃臺灣的東西。

grammar.pattern: V + 一 + V ／ V + 了 + V

grammar.pattern: V + 慣 (+了) ／ V + 不慣
grammar.explain: 慣 after a verb = to have got used to: 住慣了 (have got used to living here), 吃不慣 (can't get used to eating). The potential form has 不 in the middle.

examples.zh: 住慣了，可是還吃不慣太甜的東西。
examples.id: I've got used to living here, but I'm still not used to food that's too sweet.

grammar.pattern: 什麼/誰/哪裡 + 都 + VP
grammar.explain: A question word + 都 is not a question but means 'everything/everyone/everywhere': 什麼都好吃 (everything's tasty), 誰都喜歡 (everyone likes it). Negative: 什麼都不…

examples.zh: 我媽媽做的豆腐，誰都喜歡。
examples.id: The tofu my mum makes — everyone likes it.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 10
note: Positive: 他什麼水果都喜歡吃; 誰都認識他; 哪裡都有中國餐廳. Negative with 也/都 + 不/沒: 我什麼也沒買; 誰都不喜歡考試; 他哪兒都沒去.
沒(有)什麼 + N = hardly any: 電影院沒什麼人. Also 沒幾 + measure and 沒多少: 我沒多少錢.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 11
note: 沒有一 + measure + positive clause = not a single one: 他們一家人，沒有一個人抽菸. With a negative clause = all of them: 沒有一個臺灣的大城市沒夜市 (every big city in Taiwan has a night market).

grammar.point: 什麼都…，就是… — everything's …, it's just that …
grammar.explain: It admits that everything is good, then names ONE drawback after 就是. In questions, the important information comes after 就是.

examples.zh: 什麼都好吃，就是太鹹了。
examples.id: Everything's tasty, it's just too salty.

modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei arrive at a popular restaurant: Meimei has made a reservation. Their famous set meal includes seafood, but Dawen can't eat seafood, so he chooses the beef set.
can_do: Confirm a guess with 是不是 + VP
Conclude 'in that case' with 那

modules.exam_link: Strong negation (一點也不、從來沒) is often the key to 閱讀 Part 5 questions about someone's habits.

grammar.point: 一點也/都 + 不/沒 — not … at all
grammar.pattern: S + 一點也/都 + 不/沒 + VP
grammar.explain: Total negation: 一點也不想 (don't want to at all), 一點都沒吃 (haven't eaten any at all). 也 and 都 are the same here.

examples.id: I don't want fast food at all.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 25
note: With 一 + measure word: 一個朋友也沒有、一個字都沒寫 (not a single one).
With adjectives: 這裡的冬天一點也不冷; 中文一點都不難.

grammar.point: 從來 + 不/沒 — never (at all)
grammar.pattern: S + 從來 + 不 + V ／ 從來 + 沒 + V過
grammar.explain: 從來不 = never (a habit/principle); 從來沒V過 = have never once (experience).

examples.id: I never eat instant noodles.
I've never had oolong tea.

grammar.point: 只要…就… — as long as …, then …
grammar.explain: 只要 = as long as: the condition is ENOUGH, and the result is certain. Its partner is 就.

examples.zh: 只要帶兩張照片，就可以辦。

check.q: 'As long as you work hard, you'll definitely manage' =
options: 只要你用功，就一定可以。
只有你用功，就一定可以。
只要你用功，才一定可以。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 4
note: 只要 = a SUFFICIENT condition, nothing else needed: 你是我們學校的學生，只要拿學生證，就可以到圖書館借書.

grammar.pattern: 只有 + the only condition，(S) + 才 + result
grammar.explain: 只有 = only: that condition is the ONLY way. Its partner is 才 (not 就). Compare 只要…就… (a sufficient condition).

examples.id: You can only apply here.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 4

grammar.explain: 著 is read zháo after a verb = the goal is achieved: 睡著 (to fall asleep), 找著 (to find). Often in the potential form: 睡不著 (can't fall asleep). Different from 著 zhe (B08).

examples.id: I just couldn't get to sleep.
I've found my wallet.

modules.title: 颱風天出門會很危險的。
modules.title_py: Tái fēng tiān chū mén huì hěn wéi xiǎn de.
modules.title_id: Going out in a typhoon is bound to be dangerous.
modules.scene: A typhoon hits Taipei, and Dawen wants to go out to buy food. Meimei warns him to stay inside; after the typhoon passes, Dawen promises not to take risks again.
can_do: Express certainty/warnings: 會…的
Say 'no longer': 不再…了
Talk about safety: 危險、安全、保護、可怕
modules.exam_link: Safety warnings (typhoons, earthquakes) are classic material for 閱讀 Parts 1–3 and 聽力 Part 4.

lines.zh: 大文，颱風來了，你在哪裡？
lines.py: Dà wén, tái fēng lái le, nǐ zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Dawen, the typhoon's here — where are you?

lines.zh: 我在家。我想出去買吃的。
lines.py: Wǒ zài jiā. Wǒ xiǎng chū qù mǎi chī de.
lines.id: I'm at home. I want to go out and buy food.

lines.zh: 別出門！颱風天出門會很危險的。
lines.py: Bié chū mén! Tái fēng tiān chū mén huì hěn wēi xiǎn de.
lines.id: Don't go out! Going out in a typhoon is dangerous.

lines.zh: 可是我的泡麵都吃完了……
lines.py: Kě shì wǒ de pào miàn dōu chī wán le……
lines.id: But I've finished all my instant noodles…

lines.zh: 你家樓下有超商，別去遠的地方。
lines.py: Nǐ jiā lóu xià yǒu chāo shāng, bié qù yuǎn de dì fāng.
lines.id: There's a convenience store downstairs from your place, don't go far.

lines.zh: 好。我會保護好自己，窗戶也會關好。
lines.py: Hǎo. Wǒ huì bǎo hù hǎo zì jǐ, chuāng hù yě huì guān hǎo.
lines.id: OK. I'll keep myself safe, and I'll shut the windows tight.

lines.zh: 對，在家最安全。
lines.py: Duì, zài jiā zuì ān quán.
lines.id: Right, it's safest at home.

lines.zh: 昨天的颱風真可怕！外面很多東西都壞了。
lines.py: Zuó tiān de tái fēng zhēn kě pà! Wài miàn hěn duō dōng xi dōu huài le.
lines.id: Yesterday's typhoon was terrifying! Lots of things outside got damaged.

lines.zh: 也許明天還會下雨。
lines.py: Yě xǔ míng tiān hái huì xià yǔ.
lines.id: It might still rain tomorrow.

lines.zh: 沒關係，我會在家的。以後颱風天，我不再出門了！
lines.py: Méi guān xì, wǒ huì zài jiā de. Yǐ hòu tái fēng tiān, wǒ bú zài chū mén le!
lines.id: That's fine, I'll stay home. From now on, I won't go out on typhoon days anymore!

tasks.text: 颱風來的時候，最好在家裡，不要出門。要是一定要出門，也要注意安全，因為路上可能有東西掉下來，很危險。窗戶要關好，也要保護好家裡的小孩和老人。颱風走了以後，也許還會下雨，所以別太早出去。

grammar.explain: 會…的 stresses the speaker's conviction that something will/is bound to happen, often for warnings or promises: 會很危險的, 我會在家的.

examples.zh: 颱風天出門會很危險的。
examples.id: Going out in a typhoon is bound to be dangerous.
I'll definitely stay at home.

grammar.explain: 不再…了 = to stop doing (no longer), for a change of habit: 我不再喝咖啡了.

examples.zh: 以後颱風天，我不再出門了。
examples.id: From now on I won't go out in a typhoon again.

modules.title: 你看，天上有一顆一顆的星星！
modules.title_py: Nǐ kàn, tiān shàng yǒu yì kē yì kē de xīng xing!
modules.title_id: Look, there are stars in the sky!
modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei go camping in the mountains. At night they rest and look at the stars and the moon; in the morning they watch the sunrise and see the flowers.
can_do: Describe many things one by one: 一M一M的 (一顆一顆的星星)
Express moving down/putting down: V下 (坐下、放下)
Admire nature: 美麗、多麼…啊、星星、月亮、太陽
modules.exam_link: Descriptions of nature & the seasons appear in 閱讀 Parts 4–5 (descriptive paragraphs). 一M一M is a feature of descriptive style.

lines.zh: 大文，你看，天上有一顆一顆的星星！
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ kàn, tiān shàng yǒu yì kē yì kē de xīng xīng!
lines.id: Dawen, look, there are stars in the sky!

lines.zh: 好美！月亮也很大。
lines.py: Hǎo měi! Yuè liàng yě hěn dà.
lines.id: So beautiful! The moon's big too.

lines.zh: 走了一天，好累。我們坐下吧。
lines.py: Zǒu le yì tiān, hǎo lèi. Wǒ men zuò xià ba.
lines.id: We walked all day, I'm so tired. Let's sit down.

lines.zh: 好，把背包放下，休息一下。
lines.py: Hǎo, bǎ bēi bāo fàng xià, xiū xí yí xià.
lines.id: OK, put down your backpack and rest for a bit.

lines.zh: 在城市看不到這麼多星星。
lines.py: Zài chéng shì kàn bú dào zhè me duō xīng xīng.
lines.id: You can't see this many stars in the city.

lines.zh: 美美，快看！太陽出來了！
lines.py: Měi měi, kuài kàn! Tài yáng chū lái le!
lines.id: Meimei, look quick! The sun is coming up!

lines.zh: 好漂亮！
lines.py: Hǎo piào liàng!
lines.id: It's so beautiful!

lines.zh: 你看那一朵一朵的花！多麼漂亮啊！
lines.py: Nǐ kàn nà yì duǒ yì duǒ de huā! Duō me piào liàng a!
lines.id: Look at those flowers! How beautiful they are!

lines.zh: 臺灣每個季節都有不同的花。
lines.py: Tái wān měi ge jì jié dōu yǒu bù tóng de huā.
lines.id: In Taiwan there are different flowers every season.

lines.zh: 美麗的花、美麗的山……那我們每個季節都來吧！
lines.py: Měi lì de huā, měi lì de shān…… Nà wǒ men měi ge jì jié dōu lái ba!
lines.id: Beautiful flowers, beautiful mountains… then let's come every season!

grammar.point: 一M一M的 — one by one / lots
grammar.pattern: 一 + M + 一 + M + 的 + N
grammar.explain: The measure word is repeated with 一 to describe lots of things seen one by one: 一顆一顆的星星, 一朵一朵的花.

examples.zh: 天上有一顆一顆的星星！
examples.id: There are stars (scattered) all over the sky!

modules.title: 垃圾不是紙，就是瓶子。
modules.title_py: Lā jī bú shì zhǐ, jiù shì píng zi.
modules.title_id: The rubbish is either paper or bottles.
modules.scene: Dawen learns to sort trash in Taiwan: paper and bottles have to be separated. He then compares trash problems in Indonesia and Taiwan, and wants to share this habit when he goes home.
can_do: Say 'if it's not A, it's B': 不是…就是…
Stress with 連…都/也 + 不/沒
Talk about the environment: 環保、污染、社會、自由
modules.exam_link: Light essays about the environment & recycling appear in 閱讀 Part 5. 連…都… marks strong emphasis.

lines.zh: 美美，這個袋子裡的垃圾，不是紙，就是瓶子。都放在一起可以嗎？
lines.py: Měi měi, zhè ge dài zi lǐ de lā jī, bú shì zhǐ, jiù shì píng zi. Dōu fàng zài yì qǐ kě yǐ ma?
lines.id: Meimei, the trash in this bag is either paper or bottles. Can I put it all together?

lines.zh: 不行，紙和瓶子要放在不同的地方。
lines.py: Bù xíng, zhǐ hàn píng zi yào fàng zài bù tóng de dì fāng.
lines.id: No, paper and bottles have to go in different places.

lines.zh: 為什麼？
lines.py: Wèi shén me?
lines.id: Why?

lines.zh: 為了環保。垃圾太多，會污染環境。
lines.py: Wèi le huán bǎo. Lā jī tài duō, huì wū rǎn huán jìng.
lines.id: For the environment. Too much trash pollutes the environment.

lines.zh: 在印尼，很多地方的垃圾都放在一起。
lines.py: Zài Yìn ní, hěn duō dì fāng de lā jī dōu fàng zài yì qǐ.
lines.id: In Indonesia, in many places all the rubbish goes in together.

lines.zh: 在臺灣不行，連一個小瓶子都要放對地方。
lines.py: Zài Tái wān bù xíng, lián yí ge xiǎo píng zi dōu yào fàng duì dì fāng.
lines.id: You can't in Taiwan — even a small bottle has to go in the right place.

lines.zh: 在臺灣丟垃圾，真不自由！
lines.py: Zài Tái wān diū lā jī, zhēn bú zì yóu!
lines.id: Throwing out rubbish in Taiwan—there's no freedom at all!

lines.zh: 可是環境很乾淨啊！
lines.py: Kě shì huán jìng hěn gān jìng a!
lines.id: But the environment is clean, right?

lines.zh: 印尼的垃圾問題很嚴重，連海邊都有很多垃圾。
lines.py: Yìn ní de lā jī wèn tí hěn yán zhòng, lián hǎi biān dōu yǒu hěn duō lā jī.
lines.id: Indonesia's trash problem is serious — there's a lot of trash even on the beaches.

lines.zh: 臺灣以前也是。
lines.py: Tái wān yǐ qián yě shì.
lines.id: Taiwan used to be like that too.

lines.zh: 現在呢？
lines.py: Xiàn zài ne?
lines.id: And now?

lines.zh: 現在社會上大家都很注意環保。
lines.py: Xiàn zài shè huì shàng dà jiā dōu hěn zhù yì huán bǎo.
lines.id: Now everyone in society pays a lot of attention to the environment.

lines.zh: 我回印尼以後，也要告訴大家怎麼做！
lines.py: Wǒ huí Yìn ní yǐ hòu, yě yào gào sù dà jiā zěn me zuò!
lines.id: When I go back to Indonesia, I'll tell everyone how to do it too!

grammar.pattern: 連 + the extreme case + 都/也 + (不/沒) + VP
grammar.explain: 連 marks the most unexpected case, followed by 都/也: 連海邊都有垃圾 (even the beaches have rubbish). With a negative for strong emphasis: 連一口水都沒喝.

examples.id: Even the beaches were covered in rubbish.

options: 我連他的名字都不知道。
我都連他的名字不知道。
連我他的名字不知道都。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 10
note: 連 + the least expected case + 都/也: 連外國人都知道… (even foreigners know — so you should too); 教室裡連一個學生也沒有.
Similar: 就算是/即使…也/都 = even if: 就算是颱風，我也要去上課 (就算是 spoken, 即使 formal); 再…也/都: 你再忙也應該陪家人.

grammar.point: 不是…就是… — if it's not …, it's …
grammar.explain: There are only two possibilities: 不是 A 就是 B (if not A, then definitely B). Often used to describe habits: 不是在家，就是去打工.

examples.id: The rubbish is either paper or bottles.

check.q: 他週末不是睡覺，就是看電視 means…
options: At weekends, if he's not sleeping, he's watching TV.
He neither sleeps nor watches TV.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 16
note: 不是 A，就是 B = always one of the two: 他週末不是上網，就是看電視.
Don't confuse it with (並)不是 A，而是 B = not A but B (a correction): 她不是美國人，而是英國人.

modules.scene: Dawen remembers last year's Chinese New Year at Meimei's home. Meimei explains the New Year's Eve traditions: the special dishes, and whoever arrives first has to help cook. Dawen talks about how it's celebrated in Indonesia, and Meimei invites him again.

modules.scene: With exams and a report deadline coming up, Dawen is anxious in the library. Meimei calms him down, explains that the feeling is normal, and suggests he ask the teacher directly.

grammar.pattern: S + 不知道 + question clause (no 嗎)
grammar.explain: A question can go inside a sentence after 不知道/知道 without changing the word order: 我不知道他什麼時候來. Don't add 嗎 at the end.

examples.zh: 我不知道明天的考試難不難。

grammar.point: 不但…還/也… — not only …, but also …
grammar.pattern: S + 不但 + A，還/也 + B
grammar.explain: 不但 introduces the first point, and 還/也 adds a second (usually stronger) one.

examples.zh: 我不但擔心考試，還擔心報告。

grammar.point: 不但…而且… — not only …, but even …
grammar.pattern: S + 不但 + A，而且 + (還) + B
grammar.explain: A stronger form than 不但…還…: 而且 introduces a second, more surprising point. 還 can be added after 而且.

examples.zh: 你不但來了，而且還帶了禮物！
examples.id: You didn't just come — you brought a present too!

check.q: 'This cake is not only cheap, but tasty too' =
options: 這個蛋糕不但便宜，而且好吃。
這個蛋糕而且便宜，不但好吃。
不但這個蛋糕便宜好吃而且。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 9
note: Same subject: 不但 after the subject (臺灣的小吃不但多，而且好吃). Different subjects: 不但 before the first subject (不但我喜歡，而且我朋友也喜歡).
The topic can come first, then two parts with their own subjects: 這家店，不但東西便宜，而且老闆很好。
既…又… is like 不但…而且… for two qualities, but more formal: 既便宜又好吃。

grammar.explain: 而且 adds information in the same direction (both positive or both negative): 很輕鬆，而且很高興. It can be used without 不但.

examples.id: Relaxed, and happy too.

check.q: Choose the right word: 這家店很便宜，＿＿東西很好。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 15
note: 以為…，沒想到… = thought …, but unexpectedly …: 我以為你不來，沒想到你不但來了，而且還帶了禮物！

tasks.text: 我們班要去旅行，老師問大家的意見。一半的同學想去海邊，因為天氣很熱；有十個同學想去山上，因為山上不熱；還有幾個同學說去哪裡都可以。老師說：「那麼，我們就選擇人最多的地方吧。不願意去的同學，可以跟我說。」
tasks.question: 他們最後會去哪裡？
tasks.why: 一半的同學想去海邊 + 選擇人最多的地方 → D. A: the smaller group (十個). B: it has been decided. C: only a few people's view.

grammar.explain: 那麼 at the start of a sentence moves on from what has just been said to the next question/conclusion (a little more formal than 那, C48).

examples.id: In that case, what do you suggest?

check.q: A: 我不喜歡這個題目。 B: ＿＿，你想寫什麼？

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 12
note: 既然…，那麼… = since that is the case, then …: 既然你不想出去吃飯，那麼，我們打電話訂pizza吧. 既然 + a known fact (not a condition like 如果).

grammar.explain: 願意 = willing, happy to. Negative: 不願意 (unwilling). More polite and stronger than 想.

modules.scene: Meimei asks why Dawen moved out of the big house with the yard. Dawen explains the pros and cons of living there — neighbors who sang every night — and his new place turns out to be close to campus.
can_do: Correct an assumption with 其實
Express the original plan/situation with 本來
Weigh up pros and cons: 好處、壞處、影響、可惜、還好
modules.exam_link: Pros-and-cons essays (好處/壞處) are a classic 閱讀 Part 5 format. 其實 marks a truth that differs from the assumption.

lines.zh: 大文，你本來住在那座大房子，為什麼搬家？

lines.zh: 其實住大房子有好處，也有壞處。
lines.py: Qí shí zhù dà fáng zi yǒu hǎo chù, yě yǒu huài chù.
lines.id: Actually, living in a big house has its pros and cons.

lines.zh: 什麼好處？
lines.py: Shén me hǎo chù?
lines.id: What are the advantages?

lines.zh: 好處是很大，也有院子。壞處是房租貴，鄰居也太吵，影響我念書。
lines.py: Hǎo chù shì hěn dà, yě yǒu yuàn zi. Huài chù shì fáng zū guì, lín jū yě tài chǎo, yǐng xiǎng wǒ niàn shū.
lines.id: The pros: it's spacious and has a yard. The cons: the rent is high and the neighbors are too noisy, which affects my studying.

lines.zh: 你以前不是說那座房子很好嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ yǐ qián bú shì shuō nà zuò fáng zi hěn hǎo ma?
lines.id: Didn't you say that house was great?

lines.zh: 本來我也覺得很好，可是後來鄰居每天晚上都唱歌……
lines.py: Běn lái wǒ yě jué de hěn hǎo, kě shì hòu lái lín jū měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu chàng gē……
lines.id: At first I thought it was great too, but then the neighbors started singing every night…

lines.zh: 我了解了。可惜那個院子很漂亮！
lines.py: Wǒ liǎo jiě le. Kě xī nà ge yuàn zi hěn piào liàng!
lines.id: I see. Too bad, the yard was so pretty!

lines.zh: 還好，我的新家離學校很近，走路十分鐘。
lines.py: Hái hǎo, wǒ de xīn jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn, zǒu lù shí fēn zhōng.
lines.id: Luckily, my new place is very close to campus, a ten-minute walk.

lines.zh: 那很好。其實搬家也是很自然的事。
lines.py: Nà hěn hǎo. Qí shí bān jiā yě shì hěn zì rán de shì.
lines.id: That's good. Actually, moving is a perfectly natural thing.

modules.scene: Dawen can't get through a history book he needs for a report. Meimei encourages him and lends him a novel; the next day Dawen ends up reading the novel late into the night.
can_do: Say you are carrying on / can't carry on: V下去 (看不下去、說下去)
Say something fits / doesn't fit: V得下/V不下 (吃不下、放不下)
Use 類、另外、相當 when evaluating
modules.exam_link: V不下去 (can't carry on) and 吃不下 (can't eat any more) often appear in 聽力 Part 4 as implied reasons.

grammar.pattern: V + 下去 ／ V + 不下去
grammar.explain: 下去 after a verb = to keep going: 說下去 (carry on talking). The negative potential: 看不下去 (can't go on watching/reading).

examples.id: Go on with your story!
I can't go on reading this book.

check.q: 'I can't go on with this job' =
options: 這個工作我做不下去了。
這個工作我不做下去了。
這個工作我做下不去了。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 8
note: V下去 = keep going, don't stop: 請大家不要說話，讓他說下去.
Compare V來V去 = over and over / back and forth: 把筆轉來轉去; 看來看去，還是看不懂 (looked again and again but still didn't get it).

grammar.point: V得下／V不下 — fits / doesn't fit
grammar.explain: 下 with 得/不 expresses whether there is ROOM: 吃不下 (can't eat any more), 放得下 (still fits), 坐不下 (not enough seats).

examples.id: I can't fit anything else in now.
Is there still room on your bookshelf?

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 30
note: Example: 這個房間太小，住不下四個人 (this room can't fit four people).

modules.title: 東西太多，我拿不動！
modules.title_py: Dōng xi tài duō, wǒ ná bú dòng!
modules.title_id: There's too much stuff — I can't carry it!
modules.scene: Dawen picks Annie up at the airport; she's back from Indonesia with far too much luggage. The next day Annie wants to buy him a thank-you present, but the watch is too expensive.
can_do: Say whether you are physically able: V得動/V不動 (拿不動、走不動)
Say whether you can afford something: V得起/V不起 (買不起)
Talk about things you've brought: 帶來
modules.exam_link: 拿不動/買不起 are potential forms that are often implied reasons in 聽力 Part 4.

grammar.point: V得動／V不動 — strong enough / not strong enough
grammar.explain: 動 with 得/不 expresses whether you have enough strength to move something: 拿不動 (can't lift it), 走不動 (can't walk any further).

examples.id: There's too much stuff — I can't carry it!

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 31
note: Example: 弟弟走不動了 (my little brother can't walk any further).

grammar.point: V得起／V不起 — can afford / can't afford
grammar.explain: 起 with 得/不 expresses whether you can bear the cost: 買不起 (can't afford to buy), 住得起 (can afford to live/rent).

examples.zh: 這個手錶太貴了，我買不起。
examples.id: This watch is too expensive — I can't afford it.

check.q: The difference between 買不起 and 買不到:
options: 買不起 = can't afford (money); 買不到 = can't get hold of it
買不起 = doesn't want to buy

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 30
note: Example: 我的錢不夠，買不起鋼琴; 吉他比較便宜，我買得起.

modules.title: 啊，我想起來了！
modules.title_py: A, wǒ xiǎng qǐ lái le!
modules.title_id: Ah, now I remember!
modules.scene: Dawen forgot that today is Meimei's birthday and only remembers later. He treats her after class, but on the way it suddenly starts to rain — and Meimei just laughs.
can_do: Say you've remembered: 想起來
Say something starts to happen: V起來 (笑起來、下起雨來)
Talk about forgetting & the truth: 忘記、原來、等到、完全
modules.exam_link: 想起來 (remember) and V起來 (start) are often tested together with 看起來 (look) — three meanings of 起來 in 閱讀 Part 4.

lines.zh: 大文，今天是什麼日子，你知道嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, jīn tiān shì shén me rì zi, nǐ zhī dào ma?
lines.id: Dawen, do you know what day it is today?

lines.zh: 今天？星期五……我完全不知道。
lines.py: Jīn tiān? Xīng qī wǔ…… Wǒ wán quán bù zhī dào.
lines.id: Today? Friday… I have no idea at all.

lines.zh: 上個月你說，今天要請我吃飯……
lines.py: Shàng ge yuè nǐ shuō, jīn tiān yào qǐng wǒ chī fàn……
lines.id: Last month you said you'd treat me to a meal today…

lines.zh: 啊，我想起來了！今天是你的生日！生日快樂！
lines.py: A, wǒ xiǎng qǐ lái le! Jīn tiān shì nǐ de shēng rì! Shēng rì kuài lè!
lines.id: Ah, now I remember! Today is your birthday! Happy birthday!

lines.zh: 原來你真的忘記了！
lines.py: Yuán lái nǐ zhēn de wàng jì le!
lines.id: So you really did forget!

lines.zh: 對不起！等到下課，我請你吃你最喜歡的牛肉麵。
lines.py: Duì bù qǐ! Děng dào xià kè, wǒ qǐng nǐ chī nǐ zuì xǐ huān de niú ròu miàn.
lines.id: Sorry! After class, I'll treat you to your favorite beef noodles.

lines.zh: 好，這次別再忘記了！
lines.py: Hǎo, zhè cì bié zài wàng jì le!
lines.id: OK, don't forget again this time!

lines.zh: 你看，下起雨來了！我們都沒帶傘……
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, xià qǐ yǔ lái le! Wǒ men dōu méi dài sǎn……
lines.id: Look, it's started to rain! Neither of us brought an umbrella…

lines.zh: 真好玩！
lines.py: Zhēn hǎo wán!
lines.id: This is fun!

lines.zh: 你怎麼笑起來了？下雨有什麼好玩的？
lines.py: Nǐ zěn me xiào qǐ lái le? Xià yǔ yǒu shén me hǎo wán de?
lines.id: Why are you laughing? What's so fun about rain?

lines.zh: 我想起來了，去年我的生日也下雨！
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ lái le, qù nián wǒ de shēng rì yě xià yǔ!
lines.id: It reminds me — it rained on my birthday last year too!

tasks.text: 今天早上，我一直覺得（1）。到了學校，看到美美，我才（2）：今天是她的生日！（3）她一直在等我說「生日快樂」。我說：「對不起，我（4）。」下課以後，我請她吃飯。在路上，（5），我們都沒帶傘，可是美美笑了：「這是最特別的生日！」
tasks.why: (1) I had forgotten something. (2) remembered. (3) so for the past few days. (4) completely forgot. (5) it started to rain. 「很便宜的手機」 does not fit any gap.

tasks.text: 我奶奶今年八十多歲了，常常忘記事情。上個星期她出門買菜，回家的時候想不起來家在哪裡，就坐在公園裡等。等到天黑了，鄰居才看到她，帶她回家。原來她忘記帶手機，也忘記了我們住在哪裡。現在我們在她的衣服上寫了家裡的電話號碼。
tasks.question: 奶奶為什麼坐在公園裡？
tasks.why: 想不起來家在哪裡，就坐在公園裡等 → A. B: not mentioned. C: the neighbour just happened to see her. D: she had finished shopping.

grammar.point: V起來2 — remember / come back to mind
grammar.explain: 想起來 = to remember (something forgotten). Negative: 想不起來 (can't remember).

examples.id: Ah, now I remember!

grammar.pattern: V + 起來 ／ V + 起 + O + 來
grammar.explain: 起來 after a verb = to suddenly start: 笑起來 (start laughing), 下起雨來 (start raining — the object goes between 起 and 來).

examples.id: Look, it's starting to rain!
She started laughing.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 1
note: V起(O)來 = start to: 我剛出門，就下起雨來了 (the object goes between 起 and 來).
V著V著就…起來了 = while doing it, suddenly: 她說著說著就哭起來了.

modules.title: 我們聊起了小時候的事。
modules.title_py: Wǒ men liáo qǐ le xiǎo shí hòu de shì.
modules.title_id: We started talking about our childhood.
modules.scene: By chance, Dawen runs into his elementary school friend from Indonesia at a café in Taipei, then tells Meimei about it.
can_do: Say you start talking about a topic: V起 (聊起、說起)
Express achievement/attachment: V上 (考上、愛上、穿上)
Talk about meeting up again
modules.exam_link: V上 (考上大學) and V起 (說起) appear in narrative paragraphs in 閱讀 Part 4 and stories in 聽力 Part 4.

lines.zh: 美美，昨天在咖啡店，我見到了國小的同學！
lines.py: Měi měi, zuó tiān zài kā fēi diàn, wǒ jiàn dào le guó xiǎo de tóng xué!
lines.id: Meimei, yesterday at a café I ran into a friend from elementary school!

lines.zh: 真的嗎？你們多久沒見面了？
lines.py: Zhēn de ma? Nǐ men duō jiǔ méi jiàn miàn le?
lines.id: Really? How long since you last saw each other?

lines.zh: 十年了！我們聊起了小時候的事，聊了三個小時。
lines.py: Shí nián le! Wǒ men liáo qǐ le xiǎo shí hòu de shì, liáo le sān ge xiǎo shí.
lines.id: Ten years! We talked about when we were kids — for three hours.

lines.zh: 他還記得你小時候的樣子嗎？
lines.py: Tā hái jì de nǐ xiǎo shí hòu de yàng zi ma?
lines.id: Does he still remember what you were like as a kid?

lines.zh: 記得！他說起我以前上課常常睡覺，我們都笑了。
lines.py: Jì de! Tā shuō qǐ wǒ yǐ qián shàng kè cháng cháng shuì jiào, wǒ men dōu xiào le.
lines.id: Yes! He brought up how I used to fall asleep in class, and we both laughed.

lines.zh: 他怎麼也在臺灣？
lines.py: Tā zěn me yě zài Tái wān?
lines.id: How come he's in Taiwan too?

lines.zh: 他考上了臺灣的大學，來這裡念書。他說他已經愛上臺灣了！
lines.py: Tā kǎo shàng le Tái wān de dà xué, lái zhè lǐ niàn shū. Tā shuō tā yǐ jīng ài shàng Tái wān le!
lines.id: He got into a university in Taiwan and came here to study. He says he's already fallen in love with Taiwan!

lines.zh: 太好了！下次帶他來，我也想認識他。
lines.py: Tài hǎo le! Xià cì dài tā lái, wǒ yě xiǎng rèn shì tā.
lines.id: That's great! Bring him next time, I'd like to meet him too.

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 上個週末，我在咖啡店（1）國小同學。我們十年沒見了，一見面就（2）小時候的事。他說他現在（3），在臺北念書。我們還想起以前一起（4）的日子，說到這裡，大家都（5）。我們約好下個月再一起吃飯。
tasks.why: (1) saw my primary-school classmate. (2) started talking about. (3) got into university. (4) playing by the river. (5) started laughing. 「一雙新鞋子」 does not fit any gap.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.text: 我哥哥去年考上了臺北的大學，搬到臺北一個人住。剛開始他常常打電話回家，說很想家。後來他愛上了打球，認識了很多朋友，電話就越來越少了。上個月他回家，跟我們聊起了大學的生活，一聊就是一個晚上。媽媽說，他已經習慣了。
tasks.question: 哥哥後來為什麼不常打電話了？
tasks.why: 愛上了打球，認識了很多朋友，電話就越來越少了 → C. A: that was at the start. B: not mentioned. D: the opposite.

grammar.explain: 上 after a verb = a goal is achieved or something attaches: 考上 (to get in), 愛上 (to fall in love with), 穿上 (to put on), 關上 (to shut).

examples.id: He got into a good university.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 28–29
note: Opposite pairs: 穿上 (put on) ↔ 脫下(來) (take off); 關上 (close) ↔ 開開/打開 (open): 有點冷，請你把窗戶關上.

grammar.explain: 起 after a verb of communication = to start mentioning/talking about a topic: 聊起小時候的事, 說起以前.

modules.title: 今天吃個夠！
modules.title_py: Jīn tiān chī ge gòu!
modules.title_id: Eat as much as you like today!
modules.scene: On the weekend, Dawen and Meimei go to an all-you-can-eat buffet. The restaurant is packed and Dawen's plate is piled high, and then they plan the rest of the weekend to have as much fun as they want.
can_do: Express being full: V滿 (裝滿、坐滿)
Express 'to your heart's content': V個夠 (吃個夠、玩個夠)
Talk about buffet restaurants
modules.exam_link: 坐滿/客滿 (full) often appears in 聽力 Part 3 as a reason for a change of plan.

lines.zh: 大文，這家餐廳是吃到飽的，今天我們吃個夠！
lines.py: Dà wén, zhè jiā cān tīng shì chī dào bǎo de, jīn tiān wǒ men chī ge gòu!
lines.id: Dawen, this restaurant is all-you-can-eat — today we'll eat as much as we want!

lines.zh: 好！今天是週末，我要吃個夠！
lines.py: Hǎo! Jīn tiān shì zhōu mò, wǒ yào chī ge gòu!
lines.id: Great! It's the weekend, I'm going to eat as much as I want!

lines.zh: 你看，餐廳的人好多，位子都坐滿了。
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, cān tīng de rén hǎo duō, wèi zi dōu zuò mǎn le.
lines.id: Look, the restaurant is so crowded, all the seats are taken.

lines.zh: 還好我們訂位了。
lines.py: Hái hǎo wǒ men dìng wèi le.
lines.id: Good thing we made a reservation.

lines.zh: 你的盤子已經裝滿了！
lines.py: Nǐ de pán zi yǐ jīng zhuāng mǎn le!
lines.id: Your plate is already full!

lines.zh: 對，我要先吃肉，再吃蛋糕。
lines.py: Duì, wǒ yào xiān chī ròu, zài chī dàn gāo.
lines.id: Yes, I'm going to eat the meat first, and then the cake.

lines.zh: 我吃不下了……
lines.py: Wǒ chī bú xià le……
lines.id: I can't eat any more…

lines.zh: 週末你還想做什麼？
lines.py: Zhōu mò nǐ hái xiǎng zuò shén me?
lines.id: What else do you want to do this weekend?

lines.zh: 我要玩個夠！
lines.py: Wǒ yào wán ge gòu!
lines.id: I'm going to play as much as I want!

lines.zh: 我要看電影看個夠！
lines.py: Wǒ yào kàn diàn yǐng kàn ge gòu!
lines.id: I want to watch as many films as I like!

lines.zh: 那明天我們先去看電影吧！
lines.py: Nà míng tiān wǒ men xiān qù kàn diàn yǐng ba!
lines.id: Then let's go see a movie tomorrow!

modules.exam_link: Exam rules (allowed/not allowed) are classic material for 閱讀 Parts 1 & 3. 還可以 (not bad) is a neutral evaluation often tested in 聽力 Part 2.

grammar.point: 以 + 上/下/內/外 — above/below/within/outside (a limit)
grammar.pattern: number/place + 以上/以下/以內/以外
grammar.explain: 以 + a position word expresses a limit: 一個小時以內 (within an hour), 臺北市以外 (outside Taipei City), 十二歲以上/以下 (over/under 12).

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 31
note: 以上/以下 for numbers or limits: 零度以上 (above zero degrees), 零度以下. 以內/以外 for areas: 這條線以內 / 這條線以外. Directions: 以東、以南、以西、以北.

grammar.explain: A verb phrase + 的 can stand as a noun: 我要的 (what I want), 你說的 (what you said). Often in the pattern 我要的是… to correct something.

examples.id: What I ordered is beef.
Is this the bento you ordered?

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 22
